+"""Provider-neutral, confirmation-first protective-stop replacement workflow.
+
+The coordinator deliberately owns no durable state.  It requires an injected
+intent recorder before a mutation and keeps only short-lived in-process state
+used to serialize replacements.  A restart therefore requires normal broker
+reconciliation; it must never infer protection from this object's memory.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import inspect
+from collections.abc import Callable, Mapping
+from dataclasses import dataclass, replace
+from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
+from decimal import ROUND_FLOOR, Decimal
+from enum import StrEnum
+from types import MappingProxyType
+from typing import Protocol, runtime_checkable
+
+from mike_trade.domain.trading import TimeInForce
+
+__all__ = [
+    "StopReplacementPort",
+    "StopReplacementCoordinator",
+    "ReplacementOutcome",
+    "ReplacementStatus",
+]
+
+_ZERO = Decimal("0")
+_UNCONFIRMED_EVENT = "TRAIL_UPDATE_UNCONFIRMED"
+
+
+class _Clock(Protocol):
+    def now(self) -> datetime: ...
+
+
+class ReplacementStatus(StrEnum):
+    """Provider-neutral disposition of a stop mutation or observation."""
+
+    CONFIRMED = "CONFIRMED"
+    REJECTED = "REJECTED"
+    UNKNOWN = "UNKNOWN"
+    STOP_FILLED_DURING_REPLACE = "STOP_FILLED_DURING_REPLACE"
+    UNSUPPORTED = "UNSUPPORTED"
+
+
+def _decimal(value: object, name: str, *, positive: bool = False) -> Decimal:
+    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a Decimal")
+    if not value.is_finite():
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be finite")
+    if positive and value <= _ZERO:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be > 0")
+    return value
+
+
+def _text(value: object, name: str) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a non-empty string")
+    return value.strip()
+
+
+def _utc(value: object, name: str) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a timezone-aware datetime")
+    return value.astimezone(UTC)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class ReplacementOutcome:
+    """A mutation result; only ``CONFIRMED`` changes authoritative protection.
+
+    ``authoritative_*`` describes the last broker-verified protection.  On an
+    unconfirmed result it intentionally continues to describe the old stop.
+    ``remaining_quantity`` is populated for a fill race and excludes shares
+    already sold by the old stop.
+    """
+
+    status: ReplacementStatus
+    protected_order_id: str
+    broker_order_id: str | None = None
+    stop_price: Decimal | None = None
+    quantity: Decimal | None = None
+    filled_quantity: Decimal = _ZERO
+    remaining_quantity: Decimal | None = None
+    authoritative_order_id: str | None = None
+    authoritative_stop_price: Decimal | None = None
+    authoritative_quantity: Decimal | None = None
+    event: str | None = None
+    entries_blocked: bool = False
+    reconciliation_required: bool = False
+    coalesced: bool = False
+    coalesced_stop_price: Decimal | None = None
+    observed_at: datetime | None = None
+    detail: str = ""
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if not isinstance(self.status, ReplacementStatus):
+            object.__setattr__(self, "status", ReplacementStatus(self.status))
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self, "protected_order_id", _text(self.protected_order_id, "protected_order_id")
+        )
+        for name in ("broker_order_id", "authoritative_order_id"):
+            value = getattr(self, name)
+            if value is not None:
+                object.__setattr__(self, name, _text(value, name))
+        for name in (
+            "stop_price",
+            "quantity",
+            "authoritative_stop_price",
+            "authoritative_quantity",
+            "coalesced_stop_price",
+        ):
+            value = getattr(self, name)
+            if value is not None:
+                _decimal(value, name, positive=True)
+        if self.remaining_quantity is not None:
+            _decimal(self.remaining_quantity, "remaining_quantity")
+            if self.remaining_quantity < _ZERO:
+                raise ValueError("remaining_quantity must be >= 0")
+        _decimal(self.filled_quantity, "filled_quantity")
+        if self.filled_quantity < _ZERO:
+            raise ValueError("filled_quantity must be >= 0")
+        if self.observed_at is not None:
+            object.__setattr__(self, "observed_at", _utc(self.observed_at, "observed_at"))
+        for name in ("entries_blocked", "reconciliation_required", "coalesced"):
+            if not isinstance(getattr(self, name), bool):
+                raise TypeError(f"{name} must be bool")
+        if self.status is ReplacementStatus.CONFIRMED:
+            if self.broker_order_id is None or self.stop_price is None or self.quantity is None:
+                raise ValueError("CONFIRMED requires broker_order_id, stop_price, and quantity")
+        if self.status is ReplacementStatus.STOP_FILLED_DURING_REPLACE:
+            if self.filled_quantity <= _ZERO or self.remaining_quantity is None:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "STOP_FILLED_DURING_REPLACE requires positive filled_quantity and "
+                    "remaining_quantity"
+                )
+
+    @property
+    def effective(self) -> bool:
+        return self.status is ReplacementStatus.CONFIRMED
+
+    @property
+    def trail_update_unconfirmed(self) -> bool:
+        return self.event == _UNCONFIRMED_EVENT
+
+
+@runtime_checkable
+class StopReplacementPort(Protocol):
+    """Minimal broker boundary needed by :class:`StopReplacementCoordinator`."""
+
+    def supports_standalone_stop(self, *, qty: Decimal, tif: TimeInForce) -> bool: ...
+
+    def supports_replace(self, *, qty: Decimal, tif: TimeInForce) -> bool: ...
+
+    def price_increment(self) -> Decimal: ...
+
+    def replace_stop(
+        self,
+        order_id: str,
+        new_stop_price: Decimal,
+        qty: Decimal,
+        tif: TimeInForce,
+        client_order_id: str,
+    ) -> ReplacementOutcome: ...
+
+    def cancel_stop(self, order_id: str) -> ReplacementOutcome: ...
+
+    def lookup_order(self, order_id: str) -> ReplacementOutcome: ...
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class _Pending:
+    key: str
+    order_id: str
+    price: Decimal
+    quantity: Decimal
+    tif: TimeInForce
+    client_order_id: str
+    last_confirmed_stop: Decimal
+    requested_at: datetime
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class _Held:
+    price: Decimal
+    quantity: Decimal
+    tif: TimeInForce
+    client_order_id: str
+
+
+class StopReplacementCoordinator:
+    """Serialize, persist, submit, and confirm protective-stop mutations.
+
+    The methods are synchronous because the existing Alpaca order boundary is
+    synchronous.  A provider adapter must not return an awaitable: silently
+    losing an asynchronous mutation would violate the confirmation contract.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        port: StopReplacementPort,
+        intent_recorder: Callable[[Mapping[str, object]], object] | object,
+        *,
+        min_replace_interval: timedelta = timedelta(0),
+        clock: Callable[[], datetime] | _Clock | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        if not isinstance(min_replace_interval, timedelta) or min_replace_interval < timedelta(0):
+            raise ValueError("min_replace_interval must be a timedelta >= 0")
+        if not callable(intent_recorder) and not callable(
+            getattr(intent_recorder, "record_replacement_intent", None)
+        ):
+            raise TypeError("intent_recorder must be callable or expose record_replacement_intent")
+        self._port = port
+        self._intent_recorder = intent_recorder
+        self._min_replace_interval = min_replace_interval
+        self._clock = clock or (lambda: datetime.now(UTC))
+        self._pending: dict[str, _Pending] = {}
+        self._held: dict[str, _Held] = {}
+        self._last_request_at: dict[str, datetime] = {}
+
+    def replace_stop(
+        self,
+        *,
+        protected_order_id: str,
+        candidate_stop: Decimal,
+        last_confirmed_stop: Decimal,
+        qty: Decimal,
+        tif: TimeInForce,
+        client_order_id: str,
+        position_id: str | None = None,
+    ) -> ReplacementOutcome:
+        """Request one replacement, returning no effective change without confirmation."""
+
+        order_id = _text(protected_order_id, "protected_order_id")
+        client_id = _text(client_order_id, "client_order_id")
+        key = _text(position_id, "position_id") if position_id is not None else order_id
+        candidate = _decimal(candidate_stop, "candidate_stop", positive=True)
+        confirmed = _decimal(last_confirmed_stop, "last_confirmed_stop", positive=True)
+        quantity = _decimal(qty, "qty", positive=True)
+        resolved_tif = self._tif(tif)
+        now = self._now()
+
+        capability_error = self._capability_error(quantity, resolved_tif)
+        if capability_error is not None:
+            return self._local(
+                ReplacementStatus.UNSUPPORTED,
+                order_id,
+                confirmed,
+                quantity,
+                now,
+                capability_error,
+            )
+
+        rounded = self._round_down(candidate)
+        if rounded <= confirmed:
+            return self._local(
+                ReplacementStatus.REJECTED,
+                order_id,
+                confirmed,
+                quantity,
+                now,
+                "broker-rounded candidate must be strictly above the last confirmed stop",
+            )
+
+        pending = self._pending.get(key)
+        if pending is not None:
+            self._held[key] = _Held(rounded, quantity, resolved_tif, client_id)
+            return self._unconfirmed(
+                order_id=order_id,
+                last_stop=confirmed,
+                quantity=quantity,
+                now=now,
+                detail="replacement already pending; latest candidate held locally",
+                coalesced=True,
+                coalesced_stop=rounded,
+            )
+
+        previous = self._last_request_at.get(key)
+        if previous is not None and now - previous < self._min_replace_interval:
+            return self._local(
+                ReplacementStatus.REJECTED,
+                order_id,
+                confirmed,
+                quantity,
+                now,
+                "minimum replacement interval has not elapsed",
+            )
+
+        # A last-moment read prevents placing another stop after the old stop
+        # has already sold some or all of the protected shares.
+        observed = self._safe_lookup(order_id, now=now)
+        if observed.status is ReplacementStatus.STOP_FILLED_DURING_REPLACE:
+            return self._with_authority(observed, order_id, confirmed, quantity, now)
+
+        intent = MappingProxyType(
+            {
+                "action": "replace_stop",
+                "protected_order_id": order_id,
+                "position_id": position_id,
+                "new_stop_price": rounded,
+                "last_confirmed_stop": confirmed,
+                "qty": quantity,
+                "time_in_force": resolved_tif,
+                "client_order_id": client_id,
+                "recorded_at": now,
+            }
+        )
+        self._record_intent(intent)
+        pending = _Pending(
+            key, order_id, rounded, quantity, resolved_tif, client_id, confirmed, now
+        )
+        self._pending[key] = pending
+        self._last_request_at[key] = now
+
+        try:
+            result = self._require_outcome(
+                self._port.replace_stop(order_id, rounded, quantity, resolved_tif, client_id)
+            )
+        except Exception as exc:
+            return self._unconfirmed(
+                order_id=order_id,
+                last_stop=confirmed,
+                quantity=quantity,
+                now=now,
+                detail=f"replace call outcome unknown: {exc!r}",
+            )
+
+        normalized = self._normalize_result(result, pending, now)
+        if normalized.status is ReplacementStatus.UNKNOWN:
+            lookup = self._safe_lookup(order_id, now=now)
+            if lookup.status is not ReplacementStatus.UNKNOWN:
+                normalized = self._normalize_result(lookup, pending, now)
+        return self._finish(key, normalized)
+
+    request_replace = replace_stop
+
+    def confirm(
+        self,
+        protected_order_id: str,
+        observation: ReplacementOutcome | None = None,
+        *,
+        position_id: str | None = None,
+    ) -> ReplacementOutcome:
+        """Resolve a pending replacement from a trade update or broker lookup."""
+
+        order_id = _text(protected_order_id, "protected_order_id")
+        key = _text(position_id, "position_id") if position_id is not None else order_id
+        pending = self._pending.get(key)
+        if pending is None:
+            return ReplacementOutcome(
+                ReplacementStatus.UNKNOWN,
+                order_id,
+                authoritative_order_id=order_id,
+                event=_UNCONFIRMED_EVENT,
+                entries_blocked=True,
+                reconciliation_required=True,
+                observed_at=self._now(),
+                detail="no in-process replacement intent; broker reconciliation required",
+            )
+        now = self._now()
+        raw = self._safe_lookup(order_id, now=now) if observation is None else observation
+        result = self._normalize_result(self._require_outcome(raw), pending, now)
+        return self._finish(key, result)
+
+    confirm_replacement = confirm
+    handle_trade_update = confirm
+
+    def cancel_stop(
+        self,
+        *,
+        protected_order_id: str,
+        last_confirmed_stop: Decimal,
+        qty: Decimal,
+        client_order_id: str,
+    ) -> ReplacementOutcome:
+        """Persist and request cancellation; a request acknowledgement is not final."""
+
+        order_id = _text(protected_order_id, "protected_order_id")
+        confirmed = _decimal(last_confirmed_stop, "last_confirmed_stop", positive=True)
+        quantity = _decimal(qty, "qty", positive=True)
+        now = self._now()
+        observed = self._safe_lookup(order_id, now=now)
+        if observed.status is ReplacementStatus.STOP_FILLED_DURING_REPLACE:
+            return self._with_authority(observed, order_id, confirmed, quantity, now)
+        self._record_intent(
+            MappingProxyType(
+                {
+                    "action": "cancel_stop",
+                    "protected_order_id": order_id,
+                    "last_confirmed_stop": confirmed,
+                    "qty": quantity,
+                    "client_order_id": _text(client_order_id, "client_order_id"),
+                    "recorded_at": now,
+                }
+            )
+        )
+        try:
+            result = self._require_outcome(self._port.cancel_stop(order_id))
+        except Exception as exc:
+            return self._unconfirmed(
+                order_id=order_id,
+                last_stop=confirmed,
+                quantity=quantity,
+                now=now,
+                detail=f"cancel call outcome unknown: {exc!r}",
+            )
+        if result.status is ReplacementStatus.UNKNOWN:
+            looked_up = self._safe_lookup(order_id, now=now)
+            if looked_up.status is not ReplacementStatus.UNKNOWN:
+                result = looked_up
+        if result.status in {ReplacementStatus.REJECTED, ReplacementStatus.UNKNOWN}:
+            return self._unconfirmed(
+                order_id=order_id,
+                last_stop=confirmed,
+                quantity=quantity,
+                now=now,
+                detail=result.detail or "cancel is not broker-confirmed",
+                status=result.status,
+            )
+        return self._with_authority(result, order_id, confirmed, quantity, now)
+
+    def pending(self, protected_order_id: str) -> bool:
+        return _text(protected_order_id, "protected_order_id") in self._pending
+
+    def coalesced_candidate(self, protected_order_id: str) -> Decimal | None:
+        held = self._held.get(_text(protected_order_id, "protected_order_id"))
+        return None if held is None else held.price
+
+    def _finish(self, key: str, result: ReplacementOutcome) -> ReplacementOutcome:
+        held = self._held.get(key)
+        if result.status in {
+            ReplacementStatus.CONFIRMED,
+            ReplacementStatus.STOP_FILLED_DURING_REPLACE,
+        }:
+            self._pending.pop(key, None)
+            self._held.pop(key, None)
+        if held is not None:
+            result = replace(
+                result,
+                coalesced=True,
+                coalesced_stop_price=held.price,
+                detail=(result.detail + "; " if result.detail else "")
+                + "a newer candidate was coalesced while this request was pending",
+            )
+        return result
+
+    def _normalize_result(
+        self, result: ReplacementOutcome, pending: _Pending, now: datetime
+    ) -> ReplacementOutcome:
+        if result.status is ReplacementStatus.CONFIRMED:
+            return replace(
+                result,
+                protected_order_id=pending.order_id,
+                stop_price=result.stop_price or pending.price,
+                quantity=result.quantity or pending.quantity,
+                authoritative_order_id=result.broker_order_id,
+                authoritative_stop_price=result.stop_price or pending.price,
+                authoritative_quantity=result.quantity or pending.quantity,
+                event=None,
+                entries_blocked=False,
+                reconciliation_required=False,
+                observed_at=result.observed_at or now,
+            )
+        if result.status is ReplacementStatus.STOP_FILLED_DURING_REPLACE:
+            return self._with_authority(
+                result,
+                pending.order_id,
+                pending.last_confirmed_stop,
+                pending.quantity,
+                now,
+            )
+        if result.status in {ReplacementStatus.REJECTED, ReplacementStatus.UNKNOWN}:
+            return self._unconfirmed(
+                order_id=pending.order_id,
+                last_stop=pending.last_confirmed_stop,
+                quantity=pending.quantity,
+                now=result.observed_at or now,
+                detail=result.detail,
+                status=result.status,
+                broker_order_id=result.broker_order_id,
+            )
+        return self._with_authority(
+            result, pending.order_id, pending.last_confirmed_stop, pending.quantity, now
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _with_authority(
+        result: ReplacementOutcome,
+        order_id: str,
+        stop: Decimal,
+        quantity: Decimal,
+        now: datetime,
+    ) -> ReplacementOutcome:
+        return replace(
+            result,
+            protected_order_id=order_id,
+            authoritative_order_id=(
+                result.broker_order_id
+                if result.status is ReplacementStatus.CONFIRMED
+                else order_id
+            ),
+            authoritative_stop_price=(
+                result.stop_price if result.status is ReplacementStatus.CONFIRMED else stop
+            ),
+            authoritative_quantity=(
+                result.quantity if result.status is ReplacementStatus.CONFIRMED else quantity
+            ),
+            observed_at=result.observed_at or now,
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _unconfirmed(
+        *,
+        order_id: str,
+        last_stop: Decimal,
+        quantity: Decimal,
+        now: datetime,
+        detail: str,
+        status: ReplacementStatus = ReplacementStatus.UNKNOWN,
+        broker_order_id: str | None = None,
+        coalesced: bool = False,
+        coalesced_stop: Decimal | None = None,
+    ) -> ReplacementOutcome:
+        return ReplacementOutcome(
+            status,
+            order_id,
+            broker_order_id=broker_order_id,
+            authoritative_order_id=order_id,
+            authoritative_stop_price=last_stop,
+            authoritative_quantity=quantity,
+            event=_UNCONFIRMED_EVENT,
+            entries_blocked=True,
+            reconciliation_required=True,
+            coalesced=coalesced,
+            coalesced_stop_price=coalesced_stop,
+            observed_at=now,
+            detail=detail,
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _local(
+        status: ReplacementStatus,
+        order_id: str,
+        stop: Decimal,
+        quantity: Decimal,
+        now: datetime,
+        detail: str,
+    ) -> ReplacementOutcome:
+        return ReplacementOutcome(
+            status,
+            order_id,
+            authoritative_order_id=order_id,
+            authoritative_stop_price=stop,
+            authoritative_quantity=quantity,
+            observed_at=now,
+            detail=detail,
+        )
+
+    def _capability_error(self, qty: Decimal, tif: TimeInForce) -> str | None:
+        try:
+            standalone = self._capability("supports_standalone_stop", qty, tif)
+            replacement = self._capability("supports_replace", qty, tif)
+        except Exception as exc:
+            return f"capability query failed closed: {exc!r}"
+        if not standalone:
+            return "provider lacks a verified standalone-stop capability for this combination"
+        if not replacement:
+            return "provider lacks a verified stop-replace capability for this combination"
+        return None
+
+    def _capability(self, name: str, qty: Decimal, tif: TimeInForce) -> bool:
+        member = getattr(self._port, name)
+        value = member(qty=qty, tif=tif) if callable(member) else member
+        if inspect.isawaitable(value):
+            raise TypeError("asynchronous capability query is not supported")
+        return value is True
+
+    def _round_down(self, candidate: Decimal) -> Decimal:
+        member = self._port.price_increment
+        increment = member() if callable(member) else member
+        tick = _decimal(increment, "price_increment", positive=True)
+        rounded = (candidate / tick).to_integral_value(rounding=ROUND_FLOOR) * tick
+        return _decimal(rounded, "rounded candidate", positive=True)
+
+    def _safe_lookup(self, order_id: str, *, now: datetime) -> ReplacementOutcome:
+        try:
+            return self._require_outcome(self._port.lookup_order(order_id))
+        except Exception as exc:
+            return ReplacementOutcome(
+                ReplacementStatus.UNKNOWN,
+                order_id,
+                observed_at=now,
+                detail=f"order lookup failed: {exc!r}",
+            )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _require_outcome(value: object) -> ReplacementOutcome:
+        if inspect.isawaitable(value):
+            raise TypeError("asynchronous stop replacement ports are not supported")
+        if not isinstance(value, ReplacementOutcome):
+            raise TypeError("stop replacement port must return ReplacementOutcome")
+        return value
+
+    def _record_intent(self, intent: Mapping[str, object]) -> None:
+        recorder = self._intent_recorder
+        method = getattr(recorder, "record_replacement_intent", None)
+        result = method(intent) if callable(method) else recorder(intent)  # type: ignore[operator]
+        if inspect.isawaitable(result):
+            raise TypeError("asynchronous intent recorders are not supported")
+
+    def _now(self) -> datetime:
+        source = self._clock
+        value: object = source() if callable(source) else source.now()
+        return _utc(value, "clock result")
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _tif(value: TimeInForce | str) -> TimeInForce:
+        if isinstance(value, TimeInForce):
+            return value
+        if isinstance(value, str):
+            try:
+                return TimeInForce[value.strip().upper()]
+            except KeyError:
+                pass
+        raise ValueError("tif must be TimeInForce.DAY or TimeInForce.GTC")

+"""Offline contract tests for protective-stop replacement and Alpaca mapping."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
+from decimal import Decimal
+from typing import Any
+
+import pytest
+
+from mike_trade.brokers.alpaca.replacement import AlpacaStopReplacementAdapter
+from mike_trade.domain.trading import TimeInForce
+from mike_trade.execution.replace import (
+    ReplacementOutcome,
+    ReplacementStatus,
+    StopReplacementCoordinator,
+)
+
+NOW = datetime(2026, 10, 8, 15, 0, tzinfo=UTC)
+OLD_ID = "stop-old"
+NEW_ID = "stop-new"
+
+
+def outcome(
+    status: ReplacementStatus,
+    *,
+    order_id: str = OLD_ID,
+    broker_order_id: str | None = None,
+    price: str | None = None,
+    qty: str | None = None,
+    filled: str = "0",
+    remaining: str | None = None,
+    detail: str = "",
+) -> ReplacementOutcome:
+    return ReplacementOutcome(
+        status,
+        order_id,
+        broker_order_id=broker_order_id,
+        stop_price=None if price is None else Decimal(price),
+        quantity=None if qty is None else Decimal(qty),
+        filled_quantity=Decimal(filled),
+        remaining_quantity=None if remaining is None else Decimal(remaining),
+        observed_at=NOW,
+        detail=detail,
+    )
+
+
+class FakePort:
+    def __init__(self, events: list[str]) -> None:
+        self.events = events
+        self.standalone = True
+        self.replace_capability = True
+        self.increment = Decimal("0.01")
+        self.replace_result = outcome(ReplacementStatus.UNKNOWN)
+        self.lookup_results: list[ReplacementOutcome] = [outcome(ReplacementStatus.UNKNOWN)]
+        self.replace_calls = 0
+
+    def supports_standalone_stop(self, *, qty: Decimal, tif: TimeInForce) -> bool:
+        return self.standalone and qty == qty.to_integral_value()
+
+    def supports_replace(self, *, qty: Decimal, tif: TimeInForce) -> bool:
+        return self.replace_capability and qty == qty.to_integral_value()
+
+    def price_increment(self) -> Decimal:
+        return self.increment
+
+    def replace_stop(
+        self,
+        order_id: str,
+        new_stop_price: Decimal,
+        qty: Decimal,
+        tif: TimeInForce,
+        client_order_id: str,
+    ) -> ReplacementOutcome:
+        self.events.append("replace")
+        self.replace_calls += 1
+        return self.replace_result
+
+    def cancel_stop(self, order_id: str) -> ReplacementOutcome:
+        self.events.append("cancel")
+        return outcome(ReplacementStatus.UNKNOWN)
+
+    def lookup_order(self, order_id: str) -> ReplacementOutcome:
+        self.events.append("lookup")
+        if len(self.lookup_results) > 1:
+            return self.lookup_results.pop(0)
+        return self.lookup_results[0]
+
+
+class FakeTransport:
+    """Recorded HTTP transport: no credentials and no network implementation."""
+
+    def __init__(self, events: list[str]) -> None:
+        self.events = events
+        self.get_results: list[object] = [alpaca_order(status="accepted")]
+        self.patch_result: object = alpaca_order(
+            order_id=NEW_ID, status="accepted", stop_price="101.23"
+        )
+        self.delete_result: object = None
+        self.patch_calls = 0
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _take(items: list[object]) -> object:
+        result = items.pop(0) if len(items) > 1 else items[0]
+        if isinstance(result, BaseException):
+            raise result
+        return result
+
+    def get(self, path: str, *, params: object = None) -> object:
+        self.events.append("lookup")
+        return self._take(self.get_results)
+
+    def patch(
+        self,
+        path: str,
+        *,
+        json_body: Mapping[str, str],
+        params: object = None,
+    ) -> object:
+        self.events.append("replace")
+        self.patch_calls += 1
+        assert path == f"/v2/orders/{OLD_ID}"
+        assert json_body == {
+            "stop_price": "101.23",
+            "qty": "10",
+            "time_in_force": "gtc",
+            "client_order_id": "replace-1",
+        }
+        if isinstance(self.patch_result, BaseException):
+            raise self.patch_result
+        return self.patch_result
+
+    def delete(self, path: str, *, params: object = None) -> object:
+        self.events.append("cancel")
+        return self.delete_result
+
+
+def alpaca_order(
+    *,
+    order_id: str = OLD_ID,
+    status: str,
+    qty: str = "10",
+    filled_qty: str = "0",
+    stop_price: str = "100.00",
+    replaced_by: str | None = None,
+) -> dict[str, object]:
+    return {
+        "id": order_id,
+        "status": status,
+        "qty": qty,
+        "filled_qty": filled_qty,
+        "stop_price": stop_price,
+        "replaced_by": replaced_by,
+        "updated_at": NOW.isoformat(),
+    }
+
+
+class Clock:
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.value = NOW
+
+    def now(self) -> datetime:
+        return self.value
+
+
+def build(kind: str, scenario: str) -> tuple[object, list[str], object]:
+    events: list[str] = []
+    if kind == "memory":
+        port = FakePort(events)
+        if scenario == "confirmed":
+            port.replace_result = outcome(
+                ReplacementStatus.CONFIRMED,
+                broker_order_id=NEW_ID,
+                price="101.23",
+                qty="10",
+            )
+        elif scenario == "rejected":
+            port.replace_result = outcome(ReplacementStatus.REJECTED, detail="no")
+        elif scenario == "unknown":
+            port.replace_result = outcome(ReplacementStatus.UNKNOWN)
+            port.lookup_results = [
+                outcome(ReplacementStatus.UNKNOWN),
+                outcome(ReplacementStatus.UNKNOWN),
+            ]
+        elif scenario == "filled":
+            port.lookup_results = [
+                outcome(
+                    ReplacementStatus.STOP_FILLED_DURING_REPLACE,
+                    broker_order_id=OLD_ID,
+                    filled="10",
+                    remaining="0",
+                )
+            ]
+        elif scenario == "partial":
+            port.lookup_results = [
+                outcome(
+                    ReplacementStatus.STOP_FILLED_DURING_REPLACE,
+                    broker_order_id=OLD_ID,
+                    filled="3.5",
+                    remaining="6.5",
+                )
+            ]
+        return port, events, port
+
+    transport = FakeTransport(events)
+    if scenario == "confirmed":
+        transport.patch_result = alpaca_order(
+            order_id=NEW_ID, status="accepted", stop_price="101.23"
+        )
+        transport.get_results = [
+            alpaca_order(status="accepted"),
+            alpaca_order(status="replaced", replaced_by=NEW_ID),
+        ]
+    elif scenario == "rejected":
+        transport.patch_result = alpaca_order(status="rejected")
+    elif scenario == "unknown":
+        transport.patch_result = alpaca_order(order_id=NEW_ID, status="accepted")
+        transport.get_results = [
+            alpaca_order(status="accepted"),
+            alpaca_order(status="pending_replace"),
+        ]
+    elif scenario == "filled":
+        transport.get_results = [alpaca_order(status="filled", filled_qty="10")]
+    elif scenario == "partial":
+        transport.get_results = [
+            alpaca_order(status="partially_filled", filled_qty="3.5")
+        ]
+    adapter = AlpacaStopReplacementAdapter(transport, price_increment=Decimal("0.01"))
+    return adapter, events, transport
+
+
+def coordinator(
+    port: object,
+    events: list[str],
+    *,
+    clock: Clock | None = None,
+    interval: timedelta = timedelta(0),
+) -> StopReplacementCoordinator:
+    def record(intent: Mapping[str, object]) -> None:
+        assert intent["recorded_at"].tzinfo is not None  # type: ignore[union-attr]
+        events.append("persist")
+
+    return StopReplacementCoordinator(
+        port, record, min_replace_interval=interval, clock=clock or Clock()
+    )  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+
+
+def request(workflow: StopReplacementCoordinator, **overrides: Any) -> ReplacementOutcome:
+    kwargs: dict[str, object] = {
+        "protected_order_id": OLD_ID,
+        "candidate_stop": Decimal("101.239"),
+        "last_confirmed_stop": Decimal("100.00"),
+        "qty": Decimal("10"),
+        "tif": TimeInForce.GTC,
+        "client_order_id": "replace-1",
+    }
+    kwargs.update(overrides)
+    return workflow.replace_stop(**kwargs)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["memory", "alpaca"])
+def test_confirmed_replace_and_persist_before_broker(kind: str) -> None:
+    port, events, _ = build(kind, "confirmed")
+    result = request(coordinator(port, events))
+
+    assert result.status is ReplacementStatus.CONFIRMED
+    assert result.effective is True
+    assert result.broker_order_id == NEW_ID
+    assert result.stop_price == Decimal("101.23")
+    assert result.quantity == Decimal("10")
+    assert events.index("persist") < events.index("replace")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["memory", "alpaca"])
+def test_rejected_preserves_verified_stop_and_blocks(kind: str) -> None:

+    assert result.trail_update_unconfirmed
+    assert result.entries_blocked and result.reconciliation_required
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["memory", "alpaca"])
+def test_acknowledged_but_unconfirmed_is_unknown(kind: str) -> None:
+    port, events, _ = build(kind, "unknown")

+    assert result.effective is False
+    assert result.authoritative_stop_price == Decimal("100.00")
+    assert result.trail_update_unconfirmed
+    assert result.entries_blocked and result.reconciliation_required
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("kind", "scenario", "filled", "remaining"),
+    [
+        ("memory", "filled", "10", "0"),
+        ("alpaca", "filled", "10", "0"),
+        ("memory", "partial", "3.5", "6.5"),
+        ("alpaca", "partial", "3.5", "6.5"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_fill_race_reports_quantities_and_skips_replace(

+) -> None:

+
+    assert result.status is ReplacementStatus.STOP_FILLED_DURING_REPLACE
+    assert result.filled_quantity == Decimal(filled)
+    assert result.remaining_quantity == Decimal(remaining)

+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["memory", "alpaca"])

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["memory", "alpaca"])

+"""Alpaca implementation of the provider-neutral stop replacement port.
+
+Only the injected HTTP/SDK client is used.  This module never constructs a
+client, reads credentials, or performs implicit network access.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
+from enum import Enum
+from typing import cast
+
+from mike_trade.domain.trading import TimeInForce
+from mike_trade.execution.replace import ReplacementOutcome, ReplacementStatus
+
+__all__ = ["AlpacaStopReplacementAdapter"]
+
+_ZERO = Decimal("0")
+_OPEN = frozenset({"accepted", "new", "pending_new", "pending_replace"})
+
+
+def _positive_decimal(value: object, name: str) -> Decimal:
+    if isinstance(value, bool) or isinstance(value, float):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be Decimal, int, or str")
+    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        result = value
+    elif isinstance(value, int):
+        result = Decimal(value)
+    elif isinstance(value, str):
+        try:
+            result = Decimal(value.strip())
+        except InvalidOperation:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} is not a valid Decimal") from None
+    else:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be Decimal, int, or str")
+    if not result.is_finite() or result <= _ZERO:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a finite value > 0")
+    return result
+
+
+def _text(value: object, name: str) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a non-empty string")
+    return value.strip()
+
+
+def _value(data: object, *names: str) -> object | None:
+    if isinstance(data, Mapping):
+        for name in names:
+            if name in data:
+                return cast(object, data[name])
+        return None
+    for name in names:
+        if hasattr(data, name):
+            return cast(object, getattr(data, name))
+    return None
+
+
+class AlpacaStopReplacementAdapter:
+    """Single-shot PATCH/DELETE adapter with explicit capability flags."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        client: object,
+        *,
+        price_increment: Decimal,
+        standalone_stop_verified: bool = True,
+        replace_verified: bool = True,
+        fractional_stop_verified_in_paper: bool = False,
+    ) -> None:
+        if client is None:
+            raise TypeError("client is required")
+        self._client = client
+        self._price_increment = _positive_decimal(price_increment, "price_increment")
+        for name, value in (
+            ("standalone_stop_verified", standalone_stop_verified),
+            ("replace_verified", replace_verified),
+            ("fractional_stop_verified_in_paper", fractional_stop_verified_in_paper),
+        ):
+            if not isinstance(value, bool):
+                raise TypeError(f"{name} must be bool")
+        self._standalone_stop_verified = standalone_stop_verified
+        self._replace_verified = replace_verified
+        self._fractional_stop_verified = fractional_stop_verified_in_paper
+        self._requests: dict[str, tuple[Decimal, Decimal, str | None]] = {}
+
+    def supports_standalone_stop(self, *, qty: Decimal, tif: TimeInForce) -> bool:
+        quantity = _positive_decimal(qty, "qty")
+        self._tif(tif)
+        return self._standalone_stop_verified and (
+            quantity == quantity.to_integral_value() or self._fractional_stop_verified
+        )
+
+    def supports_replace(self, *, qty: Decimal, tif: TimeInForce) -> bool:
+        quantity = _positive_decimal(qty, "qty")
+        self._tif(tif)
+        return self._replace_verified and (
+            quantity == quantity.to_integral_value() or self._fractional_stop_verified
+        )
+
+    def price_increment(self) -> Decimal:
+        return self._price_increment
+
+    def replace_stop(
+        self,
+        order_id: str,
+        new_stop_price: Decimal,
+        qty: Decimal,
+        tif: TimeInForce,
+        client_order_id: str,
+    ) -> ReplacementOutcome:
+        old_id = _text(order_id, "order_id")
+        price = _positive_decimal(new_stop_price, "new_stop_price")
+        quantity = _positive_decimal(qty, "qty")
+        tif_value = self._tif(tif)
+        client_id = _text(client_order_id, "client_order_id")
+        if not self.supports_standalone_stop(qty=quantity, tif=tif):
+            return self._unsupported(old_id, "standalone stop combination is not verified")
+        if not self.supports_replace(qty=quantity, tif=tif):
+            return self._unsupported(old_id, "stop replacement combination is not verified")
+        body = {
+            "stop_price": str(price),
+            "qty": str(quantity),
+            "time_in_force": tif_value,
+            "client_order_id": client_id,
+        }
+        # Record the expected values before PATCH so even a compact
+        # ``status=replaced`` response can be normalized without guessing.
+        self._requests[old_id] = (price, quantity, None)
+        try:
+            data = self._patch(old_id, body)
+        except Exception as exc:
+            return ReplacementOutcome(
+                ReplacementStatus.UNKNOWN,
+                old_id,
+                observed_at=datetime.now(UTC),
+                detail=f"Alpaca replace outcome unknown: {exc!r}",
+            )
+        result = self._map(data, protected_order_id=old_id, mutation="replace")
+        self._requests[old_id] = (price, quantity, result.broker_order_id)
+        if result.status is ReplacementStatus.CONFIRMED:
+            result = self._apply_requested(result, old_id)
+        return result
+
+    def cancel_stop(self, order_id: str) -> ReplacementOutcome:
+        old_id = _text(order_id, "order_id")
+        try:
+            data = self._delete(old_id)
+        except Exception as exc:
+            status_code = getattr(exc, "status_code", None)
+            if status_code not in {404, 422}:
+                return ReplacementOutcome(
+                    ReplacementStatus.UNKNOWN,
+                    old_id,
+                    observed_at=datetime.now(UTC),
+                    detail=f"Alpaca cancel outcome unknown: {exc!r}",
+                )
+            # A terminal response needs lookup to distinguish cancel from fill.
+            return self.lookup_order(old_id)
+        if data is None:
+            return ReplacementOutcome(
+                ReplacementStatus.UNKNOWN,
+                old_id,
+                observed_at=datetime.now(UTC),
+                detail="Alpaca accepted cancellation; final status is unconfirmed",
+            )
+        return self._map(data, protected_order_id=old_id, mutation="cancel")
+
+    def lookup_order(self, order_id: str) -> ReplacementOutcome:
+        old_id = _text(order_id, "order_id")
+        try:
+            data = self._get(old_id)
+        except Exception as exc:
+            return ReplacementOutcome(
+                ReplacementStatus.UNKNOWN,
+                old_id,
+                observed_at=datetime.now(UTC),
+                detail=f"Alpaca lookup failed: {exc!r}",
+            )
+        if data is None:
+            return ReplacementOutcome(
+                ReplacementStatus.UNKNOWN,
+                old_id,
+                observed_at=datetime.now(UTC),
+                detail="Alpaca lookup returned no order",
+            )
+        result = self._map(data, protected_order_id=old_id, mutation="lookup")
+        if result.status is ReplacementStatus.CONFIRMED and old_id in self._requests:
+            result = self._apply_requested(result, old_id)
+        return result
+
+    def outcome_from_trade_update(
+        self, update: object, *, protected_order_id: str
+    ) -> ReplacementOutcome:
+        """Map an already-authenticated Alpaca trade update without doing I/O."""
+
+        payload = _value(update, "order") or update
+        event = _value(update, "event")
+        if event is not None:
+            if isinstance(payload, Mapping):
+                payload = dict(payload)
+                payload["status"] = getattr(event, "value", event)
+            elif hasattr(payload, "status"):
+                # Normalized TradeUpdate.order already carries the same status.
+                pass
+        result = self._map(payload, protected_order_id=protected_order_id, mutation="update")
+        if result.status is ReplacementStatus.CONFIRMED and protected_order_id in self._requests:
+            result = self._apply_requested(result, protected_order_id)
+        return result
+
+    def _apply_requested(self, result: ReplacementOutcome, old_id: str) -> ReplacementOutcome:
+        from dataclasses import replace
+
+        price, quantity, submitted_id = self._requests[old_id]
+        return replace(
+            result,
+            broker_order_id=result.broker_order_id or submitted_id or old_id,
+            stop_price=price,
+            quantity=quantity,
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _unsupported(order_id: str, detail: str) -> ReplacementOutcome:
+        return ReplacementOutcome(
+            ReplacementStatus.UNSUPPORTED,
+            order_id,
+            observed_at=datetime.now(UTC),
+            detail=detail,
+        )
+
+    def _map(
+        self, data: object, *, protected_order_id: str, mutation: str
+    ) -> ReplacementOutcome:
+        status_value = _value(data, "status")
+        raw_status = getattr(status_value, "value", status_value)
+        status = str(raw_status or "unknown").strip().lower()
+        order_id_value = _value(data, "id", "order_id", "broker_order_id")
+        current_id = str(order_id_value).strip() if order_id_value else None
+        replacement_value = _value(data, "replaced_by", "replacement_order_id")
+        replacement_id = str(replacement_value).strip() if replacement_value else None
+        qty = self._optional_decimal(_value(data, "qty", "quantity"), "qty")
+        filled = self._nonnegative_decimal(
+            _value(data, "filled_qty", "filled_quantity"), "filled_qty"
+        ) or _ZERO
+        stop = self._optional_decimal(_value(data, "stop_price"), "stop_price")
+        observed_at = self._timestamp(_value(data, "updated_at", "timestamp"))
+
+        if status == "replaced":
+            return ReplacementOutcome(
+                ReplacementStatus.CONFIRMED,
+                protected_order_id,
+                broker_order_id=replacement_id or current_id or protected_order_id,
+                stop_price=stop or self._requested_price(protected_order_id),
+                quantity=qty or self._requested_qty(protected_order_id),
+                observed_at=observed_at,
+                detail="Alpaca confirmed order replacement",
+            )
+        if status in {"filled", "partially_filled", "partial_fill"}:
+            if filled <= _ZERO and status == "filled" and qty is not None:
+                filled = qty
+            remaining = max(_ZERO, (qty or filled) - filled)
+            return ReplacementOutcome(
+                ReplacementStatus.STOP_FILLED_DURING_REPLACE,
+                protected_order_id,
+                broker_order_id=current_id or protected_order_id,
+                filled_quantity=filled,
+                remaining_quantity=remaining,
+                observed_at=observed_at,
+                detail=f"old Alpaca stop was {status} during {mutation}",
+            )
+        if status == "rejected":
+            return ReplacementOutcome(
+                ReplacementStatus.REJECTED,
+                protected_order_id,
+                broker_order_id=current_id,
+                observed_at=observed_at,
+                detail="Alpaca rejected the stop mutation",
+            )
+        if status == "canceled" and mutation in {"cancel", "lookup"}:
+            # A confirmed cancellation is represented as CONFIRMED.  The
+            # coordinator's cancel path supplies its prior stop/quantity.
+            requested_price = self._requested_price(protected_order_id)
+            requested_qty = self._requested_qty(protected_order_id)
+            if requested_price is not None and requested_qty is not None:
+                return ReplacementOutcome(
+                    ReplacementStatus.CONFIRMED,
+                    protected_order_id,
+                    broker_order_id=current_id or protected_order_id,
+                    stop_price=requested_price,
+                    quantity=requested_qty,
+                    observed_at=observed_at,
+                    detail="Alpaca confirmed cancellation",
+                )
+            return ReplacementOutcome(
+                ReplacementStatus.UNKNOWN,
+                protected_order_id,
+                broker_order_id=current_id,
+                observed_at=observed_at,
+                detail="Alpaca confirmed cancellation; no replacement is confirmed",
+            )
+        detail = (
+            "Alpaca acknowledged replacement but has not confirmed it"
+            if status in _OPEN
+            else f"Alpaca status {status!r} does not confirm replacement"
+        )
+        return ReplacementOutcome(
+            ReplacementStatus.UNKNOWN,
+            protected_order_id,
+            broker_order_id=current_id,
+            stop_price=stop,
+            quantity=qty,
+            observed_at=observed_at,
+            detail=detail,
+        )
+
+    def _patch(self, order_id: str, body: Mapping[str, str]) -> object:
+        method = getattr(self._client, "patch", None)
+        if callable(method):
+            return method(f"/v2/orders/{order_id}", json_body=dict(body), params=None)
+        method = getattr(self._client, "replace_order_by_id", None)
+        if callable(method):
+            return method(order_id, **dict(body))
+        method = getattr(self._client, "replace_order", None)
+        if callable(method):
+            return method(order_id, **dict(body))
+        raise TypeError("client must expose patch, replace_order_by_id, or replace_order")
+
+    def _delete(self, order_id: str) -> object:
+        method = getattr(self._client, "delete", None)
+        if callable(method):
+            return method(f"/v2/orders/{order_id}", params=None)
+        for name in ("cancel_order_by_id", "cancel_order"):
+            method = getattr(self._client, name, None)
+            if callable(method):
+                return method(order_id)
+        raise TypeError("client must expose delete, cancel_order_by_id, or cancel_order")
+
+    def _get(self, order_id: str) -> object:
+        method = getattr(self._client, "get", None)
+        if callable(method):
+            return method(f"/v2/orders/{order_id}", params=None)
+        for name in ("get_order_by_id", "get_order"):
+            method = getattr(self._client, name, None)
+            if callable(method):
+                return method(order_id)
+        raise TypeError("client must expose get, get_order_by_id, or get_order")
+
+    def _requested_price(self, order_id: str) -> Decimal | None:
+        request = self._requests.get(order_id)
+        return None if request is None else request[0]
+
+    def _requested_qty(self, order_id: str) -> Decimal | None:
+        request = self._requests.get(order_id)
+        return None if request is None else request[1]
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _optional_decimal(value: object | None, name: str) -> Decimal | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        return _positive_decimal(value, name)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _nonnegative_decimal(value: object | None, name: str) -> Decimal | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        if isinstance(value, bool) or isinstance(value, float):
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be Decimal, int, or str")
+        try:
+            result = value if isinstance(value, Decimal) else Decimal(str(value).strip())
+        except (InvalidOperation, ValueError):
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} is not a valid Decimal") from None
+        if not result.is_finite() or result < _ZERO:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be finite and >= 0")
+        return result
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _timestamp(value: object | None) -> datetime:
+        if value is None:
+            return datetime.now(UTC)
+        if isinstance(value, datetime):
+            parsed = value
+        elif isinstance(value, str):
+            text = value.strip().replace("Z", "+00:00")
+            parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(text)
+        else:
+            return datetime.now(UTC)
+        if parsed.tzinfo is None or parsed.utcoffset() is None:
+            raise ValueError("Alpaca timestamp must be timezone-aware")
+        return parsed.astimezone(UTC)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _tif(value: TimeInForce | str | Enum) -> str:
+        raw = getattr(value, "value", value)
+        if not isinstance(raw, str) or raw.strip().lower() not in {"day", "gtc"}:
+            raise ValueError("tif must be DAY or GTC")
+        return raw.strip().lower()

+"""Provider-neutral, confirmation-first protective-stop replacement workflow.
+
+The coordinator deliberately owns no durable state.  It requires an injected
+intent recorder before a mutation and keeps only short-lived in-process state
+used to serialize replacements.  A restart therefore requires normal broker
+reconciliation; it must never infer protection from this object's memory.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import inspect
+from collections.abc import Callable, Mapping
+from dataclasses import dataclass, replace
+from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
+from decimal import ROUND_FLOOR, Decimal
+from enum import StrEnum
+from types import MappingProxyType
+from typing import Protocol, runtime_checkable
+
+from mike_trade.domain.trading import TimeInForce
+
+__all__ = [
+    "StopReplacementPort",
+    "StopReplacementCoordinator",
+    "ReplacementOutcome",
+    "ReplacementStatus",
+]
+
+_ZERO = Decimal("0")
+_UNCONFIRMED_EVENT = "TRAIL_UPDATE_UNCONFIRMED"
+
+
+class _Clock(Protocol):
+    def now(self) -> datetime: ...
+
+
+class ReplacementStatus(StrEnum):
+    """Provider-neutral disposition of a stop mutation or observation."""
+
+    CONFIRMED = "CONFIRMED"
+    REJECTED = "REJECTED"
+    UNKNOWN = "UNKNOWN"
+    STOP_FILLED_DURING_REPLACE = "STOP_FILLED_DURING_REPLACE"
+    UNSUPPORTED = "UNSUPPORTED"
+
+
+def _decimal(value: object, name: str, *, positive: bool = False) -> Decimal:
+    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a Decimal")
+    if not value.is_finite():
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be finite")
+    if positive and value <= _ZERO:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be > 0")
+    return value
+
+
+def _text(value: object, name: str) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a non-empty string")
+    return value.strip()
+
+
+def _utc(value: object, name: str) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a timezone-aware datetime")
+    return value.astimezone(UTC)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class ReplacementOutcome:
+    """A mutation result; only ``CONFIRMED`` changes authoritative protection.
+
+    ``authoritative_*`` describes the last broker-verified protection.  On an
+    unconfirmed result it intentionally continues to describe the old stop.
+    ``remaining_quantity`` is populated for a fill race and excludes shares
+    already sold by the old stop.
+    """
+
+    status: ReplacementStatus
+    protected_order_id: str
+    broker_order_id: str | None = None
+    stop_price: Decimal | None = None
+    quantity: Decimal | None = None
+    filled_quantity: Decimal = _ZERO
+    remaining_quantity: Decimal | None = None
+    authoritative_order_id: str | None = None
+    authoritative_stop_price: Decimal | None = None
+    authoritative_quantity: Decimal | None = None
+    event: str | None = None
+    entries_blocked: bool = False
+    reconciliation_required: bool = False
+    coalesced: bool = False
+    coalesced_stop_price: Decimal | None = None
+    observed_at: datetime | None = None
+    detail: str = ""
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if not isinstance(self.status, ReplacementStatus):
+            object.__setattr__(self, "status", ReplacementStatus(self.status))
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self, "protected_order_id", _text(self.protected_order_id, "protected_order_id")
+        )
+        for name in ("broker_order_id", "authoritative_order_id"):
+            value = getattr(self, name)
+            if value is not None:
+                object.__setattr__(self, name, _text(value, name))
+        for name in (
+            "stop_price",
+            "quantity",
+            "authoritative_stop_price",
+            "authoritative_quantity",
+            "coalesced_stop_price",
+        ):
+            value = getattr(self, name)
+            if value is not None:
+                _decimal(value, name, positive=True)
+        if self.remaining_quantity is not None:
+            _decimal(self.remaining_quantity, "remaining_quantity")
+            if self.remaining_quantity < _ZERO:
+                raise ValueError("remaining_quantity must be >= 0")
+        _decimal(self.filled_quantity, "filled_quantity")
+        if self.filled_quantity < _ZERO:
+            raise ValueError("filled_quantity must be >= 0")
+        if self.observed_at is not None:
+            object.__setattr__(self, "observed_at", _utc(self.observed_at, "observed_at"))
+        for name in ("entries_blocked", "reconciliation_required", "coalesced"):
+            if not isinstance(getattr(self, name), bool):
+                raise TypeError(f"{name} must be bool")
+        if self.status is ReplacementStatus.CONFIRMED:
+            if self.broker_order_id is None or self.stop_price is None or self.quantity is None:
+                raise ValueError("CONFIRMED requires broker_order_id, stop_price, and quantity")
+        if self.status is ReplacementStatus.STOP_FILLED_DURING_REPLACE:
+            if self.filled_quantity <= _ZERO or self.remaining_quantity is None:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "STOP_FILLED_DURING_REPLACE requires positive filled_quantity and "
+                    "remaining_quantity"
+                )
+
+    @property
+    def effective(self) -> bool:
+        return self.status is ReplacementStatus.CONFIRMED
+
+    @property
+    def trail_update_unconfirmed(self) -> bool:
+        return self.event == _UNCONFIRMED_EVENT
+
+
+@runtime_checkable
+class StopReplacementPort(Protocol):
+    """Minimal broker boundary needed by :class:`StopReplacementCoordinator`."""
+
+    def supports_standalone_stop(self, *, qty: Decimal, tif: TimeInForce) -> bool: ...
+
+    def supports_replace(self, *, qty: Decimal, tif: TimeInForce) -> bool: ...
+
+    def price_increment(self) -> Decimal: ...
+
+    def replace_stop(
+        self,
+        order_id: str,
+        new_stop_price: Decimal,
+        qty: Decimal,
+        tif: TimeInForce,
+        client_order_id: str,
+    ) -> ReplacementOutcome: ...
+
+    def cancel_stop(self, order_id: str) -> ReplacementOutcome: ...
+
+    def lookup_order(self, order_id: str) -> ReplacementOutcome: ...
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class _Pending:
+    key: str
+    order_id: str
+    price: Decimal
+    quantity: Decimal
+    tif: TimeInForce
+    client_order_id: str
+    last_confirmed_stop: Decimal
+    requested_at: datetime
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class _Held:
+    price: Decimal
+    quantity: Decimal
+    tif: TimeInForce
+    client_order_id: str
+
+
+class StopReplacementCoordinator:
+    """Serialize, persist, submit, and confirm protective-stop mutations.
+
+    The methods are synchronous because the existing Alpaca order boundary is
+    synchronous.  A provider adapter must not return an awaitable: silently
+    losing an asynchronous mutation would violate the confirmation contract.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        port: StopReplacementPort,
+        intent_recorder: Callable[[Mapping[str, object]], object] | object,
+        *,
+        min_replace_interval: timedelta = timedelta(0),
+        clock: Callable[[], datetime] | _Clock | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        if not isinstance(min_replace_interval, timedelta) or min_replace_interval < timedelta(0):
+            raise ValueError("min_replace_interval must be a timedelta >= 0")
+        if not callable(intent_recorder) and not callable(
+            getattr(intent_recorder, "record_replacement_intent", None)
+        ):
+            raise TypeError("intent_recorder must be callable or expose record_replacement_intent")
+        self._port = port
+        self._intent_recorder = intent_recorder
+        self._min_replace_interval = min_replace_interval
+        self._clock = clock or (lambda: datetime.now(UTC))
+        self._pending: dict[str, _Pending] = {}
+        self._held: dict[str, _Held] = {}
+        self._last_request_at: dict[str, datetime] = {}
+
+    def replace_stop(
+        self,
+        *,
+        protected_order_id: str,
+        candidate_stop: Decimal,
+        last_confirmed_stop: Decimal,
+        qty: Decimal,
+        tif: TimeInForce,
+        client_order_id: str,
+        position_id: str | None = None,
+    ) -> ReplacementOutcome:
+        """Request one replacement, returning no effective change without confirmation."""
+
+        order_id = _text(protected_order_id, "protected_order_id")
+        client_id = _text(client_order_id, "client_order_id")
+        key = _text(position_id, "position_id") if position_id is not None else order_id
+        candidate = _decimal(candidate_stop, "candidate_stop", positive=True)
+        confirmed = _decimal(last_confirmed_stop, "last_confirmed_stop", positive=True)
+        quantity = _decimal(qty, "qty", positive=True)
+        resolved_tif = self._tif(tif)
+        now = self._now()
+
+        capability_error = self._capability_error(quantity, resolved_tif)
+        if capability_error is not None:
+            return self._local(
+                ReplacementStatus.UNSUPPORTED,
+                order_id,
+                confirmed,
+                quantity,
+                now,
+                capability_error,
+            )
+
+        rounded = self._round_down(candidate)
+        if rounded <= confirmed:
+            return self._local(
+                ReplacementStatus.REJECTED,
+                order_id,
+                confirmed,
+                quantity,
+                now,
+                "broker-rounded candidate must be strictly above the last confirmed stop",
+            )
+
+        pending = self._pending.get(key)
+        if pending is not None:
+            self._held[key] = _Held(rounded, quantity, resolved_tif, client_id)
+            return self._unconfirmed(
+                order_id=order_id,
+                last_stop=confirmed,
+                quantity=quantity,
+                now=now,
+                detail="replacement already pending; latest candidate held locally",
+                coalesced=True,
+                coalesced_stop=rounded,
+            )
+
+        previous = self._last_request_at.get(key)
+        if previous is not None and now - previous < self._min_replace_interval:
+            return self._local(
+                ReplacementStatus.REJECTED,
+                order_id,
+                confirmed,
+                quantity,
+                now,
+                "minimum replacement interval has not elapsed",
+            )
+
+        # A last-moment read prevents placing another stop after the old stop
+        # has already sold some or all of the protected shares.
+        observed = self._safe_lookup(order_id, now=now)
+        if observed.status is ReplacementStatus.STOP_FILLED_DURING_REPLACE:
+            return self._with_authority(observed, order_id, confirmed, quantity, now)
+
+        intent = MappingProxyType(
+            {
+                "action": "replace_stop",
+                "protected_order_id": order_id,
+                "position_id": position_id,
+                "new_stop_price": rounded,
+                "last_confirmed_stop": confirmed,
+                "qty": quantity,
+                "time_in_force": resolved_tif,
+                "client_order_id": client_id,
+                "recorded_at": now,
+            }
+        )
+        self._record_intent(intent)
+        pending = _Pending(
+            key, order_id, rounded, quantity, resolved_tif, client_id, confirmed, now
+        )
+        self._pending[key] = pending
+        self._last_request_at[key] = now
+
+        try:
+            result = self._require_outcome(
+                self._port.replace_stop(order_id, rounded, quantity, resolved_tif, client_id)
+            )
+        except Exception as exc:
+            return self._unconfirmed(
+                order_id=order_id,
+                last_stop=confirmed,
+                quantity=quantity,
+                now=now,
+                detail=f"replace call outcome unknown: {exc!r}",
+            )
+
+        normalized = self._normalize_result(result, pending, now)
+        if normalized.status is ReplacementStatus.UNKNOWN:
+            lookup = self._safe_lookup(order_id, now=now)
+            if lookup.status is not ReplacementStatus.UNKNOWN:
+                normalized = self._normalize_result(lookup, pending, now)
+        return self._finish(key, normalized)
+
+    request_replace = replace_stop
+
+    def confirm(
+        self,
+        protected_order_id: str,
+        observation: ReplacementOutcome | None = None,
+        *,
+        position_id: str | None = None,
+    ) -> ReplacementOutcome:
+        """Resolve a pending replacement from a trade update or broker lookup."""
+
+        order_id = _text(protected_order_id, "protected_order_id")
+        key = _text(position_id, "position_id") if position_id is not None else order_id
+        pending = self._pending.get(key)
+        if pending is None:
+            return ReplacementOutcome(
+                ReplacementStatus.UNKNOWN,
+                order_id,
+                authoritative_order_id=order_id,
+                event=_UNCONFIRMED_EVENT,
+                entries_blocked=True,
+                reconciliation_required=True,
+                observed_at=self._now(),
+                detail="no in-process replacement intent; broker reconciliation required",
+            )
+        now = self._now()
+        raw = self._safe_lookup(order_id, now=now) if observation is None else observation
+        result = self._normalize_result(self._require_outcome(raw), pending, now)
+        return self._finish(key, result)
+
+    confirm_replacement = confirm
+    handle_trade_update = confirm
+
+    def cancel_stop(
+        self,
+        *,
+        protected_order_id: str,
+        last_confirmed_stop: Decimal,
+        qty: Decimal,
+        client_order_id: str,
+    ) -> ReplacementOutcome:
+        """Persist and request cancellation; a request acknowledgement is not final."""
+
+        order_id = _text(protected_order_id, "protected_order_id")
+        confirmed = _decimal(last_confirmed_stop, "last_confirmed_stop", positive=True)
+        quantity = _decimal(qty, "qty", positive=True)
+        now = self._now()
+        observed = self._safe_lookup(order_id, now=now)
+        if observed.status is ReplacementStatus.STOP_FILLED_DURING_REPLACE:
+            return self._with_authority(observed, order_id, confirmed, quantity, now)
+        self._record_intent(
+            MappingProxyType(
+                {
+                    "action": "cancel_stop",
+                    "protected_order_id": order_id,
+                    "last_confirmed_stop": confirmed,
+                    "qty": quantity,
+                    "client_order_id": _text(client_order_id, "client_order_id"),
+                    "recorded_at": now,
+                }
+            )
+        )
+        try:
+            result = self._require_outcome(self._port.cancel_stop(order_id))
+        except Exception as exc:
+            return self._unconfirmed(
+                order_id=order_id,
+                last_stop=confirmed,
+                quantity=quantity,
+                now=now,
+                detail=f"cancel call outcome unknown: {exc!r}",
+            )
+        if result.status is ReplacementStatus.UNKNOWN:
+            looked_up = self._safe_lookup(order_id, now=now)
+            if looked_up.status is not ReplacementStatus.UNKNOWN:
+                result = looked_up
+        if result.status in {ReplacementStatus.REJECTED, ReplacementStatus.UNKNOWN}:
+            return self._unconfirmed(
+                order_id=order_id,
+                last_stop=confirmed,
+                quantity=quantity,
+                now=now,
+                detail=result.detail or "cancel is not broker-confirmed",
+                status=result.status,
+            )
+        return self._with_authority(result, order_id, confirmed, quantity, now)
+
+    def pending(self, protected_order_id: str) -> bool:
+        return _text(protected_order_id, "protected_order_id") in self._pending
+
+    def coalesced_candidate(self, protected_order_id: str) -> Decimal | None:
+        held = self._held.get(_text(protected_order_id, "protected_order_id"))
+        return None if held is None else held.price
+
+    def _finish(self, key: str, result: ReplacementOutcome) -> ReplacementOutcome:
+        held = self._held.get(key)
+        if result.status in {
+            ReplacementStatus.CONFIRMED,
+            ReplacementStatus.STOP_FILLED_DURING_REPLACE,
+        }:
+            self._pending.pop(key, None)
+            self._held.pop(key, None)
+        if held is not None:
+            result = replace(
+                result,
+                coalesced=True,
+                coalesced_stop_price=held.price,
+                detail=(result.detail + "; " if result.detail else "")
+                + "a newer candidate was coalesced while this request was pending",
+            )
+        return result
+
+    def _normalize_result(
+        self, result: ReplacementOutcome, pending: _Pending, now: datetime
+    ) -> ReplacementOutcome:
+        if result.status is ReplacementStatus.CONFIRMED:
+            return replace(
+                result,
+                protected_order_id=pending.order_id,
+                stop_price=result.stop_price or pending.price,
+                quantity=result.quantity or pending.quantity,
+                authoritative_order_id=result.broker_order_id,
+                authoritative_stop_price=result.stop_price or pending.price,
+                authoritative_quantity=result.quantity or pending.quantity,
+                event=None,
+                entries_blocked=False,
+                reconciliation_required=False,
+                observed_at=result.observed_at or now,
+            )
+        if result.status is ReplacementStatus.STOP_FILLED_DURING_REPLACE:
+            return self._with_authority(
+                result,
+                pending.order_id,
+                pending.last_confirmed_stop,
+                pending.quantity,
+                now,
+            )
+        if result.status in {ReplacementStatus.REJECTED, ReplacementStatus.UNKNOWN}:
+            return self._unconfirmed(
+                order_id=pending.order_id,
+                last_stop=pending.last_confirmed_stop,
+                quantity=pending.quantity,
+                now=result.observed_at or now,
+                detail=result.detail,
+                status=result.status,
+                broker_order_id=result.broker_order_id,
+            )
+        return self._with_authority(
+            result, pending.order_id, pending.last_confirmed_stop, pending.quantity, now
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _with_authority(
+        result: ReplacementOutcome,
+        order_id: str,
+        stop: Decimal,
+        quantity: Decimal,
+        now: datetime,
+    ) -> ReplacementOutcome:
+        return replace(
+            result,
+            protected_order_id=order_id,
+            authoritative_order_id=(
+                result.broker_order_id
+                if result.status is ReplacementStatus.CONFIRMED
+                else order_id
+            ),
+            authoritative_stop_price=(
+                result.stop_price if result.status is ReplacementStatus.CONFIRMED else stop
+            ),
+            authoritative_quantity=(
+                result.quantity if result.status is ReplacementStatus.CONFIRMED else quantity
+            ),
+            observed_at=result.observed_at or now,
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _unconfirmed(
+        *,
+        order_id: str,
+        last_stop: Decimal,
+        quantity: Decimal,
+        now: datetime,
+        detail: str,
+        status: ReplacementStatus = ReplacementStatus.UNKNOWN,
+        broker_order_id: str | None = None,
+        coalesced: bool = False,
+        coalesced_stop: Decimal | None = None,
+    ) -> ReplacementOutcome:
+        return ReplacementOutcome(
+            status,
+            order_id,
+            broker_order_id=broker_order_id,
+            authoritative_order_id=order_id,
+            authoritative_stop_price=last_stop,
+            authoritative_quantity=quantity,
+            event=_UNCONFIRMED_EVENT,
+            entries_blocked=True,
+            reconciliation_required=True,
+            coalesced=coalesced,
+            coalesced_stop_price=coalesced_stop,
+            observed_at=now,
+            detail=detail,
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _local(
+        status: ReplacementStatus,
+        order_id: str,
+        stop: Decimal,
+        quantity: Decimal,
+        now: datetime,
+        detail: str,
+    ) -> ReplacementOutcome:
+        return ReplacementOutcome(
+            status,
+            order_id,
+            authoritative_order_id=order_id,
+            authoritative_stop_price=stop,
+            authoritative_quantity=quantity,
+            observed_at=now,
+            detail=detail,
+        )
+
+    def _capability_error(self, qty: Decimal, tif: TimeInForce) -> str | None:
+        try:
+            standalone = self._capability("supports_standalone_stop", qty, tif)
+            replacement = self._capability("supports_replace", qty, tif)
+        except Exception as exc:
+            return f"capability query failed closed: {exc!r}"
+        if not standalone:
+            return "provider lacks a verified standalone-stop capability for this combination"
+        if not replacement:
+            return "provider lacks a verified stop-replace capability for this combination"
+        return None
+
+    def _capability(self, name: str, qty: Decimal, tif: TimeInForce) -> bool:
+        member = getattr(self._port, name)
+        value = member(qty=qty, tif=tif) if callable(member) else member
+        if inspect.isawaitable(value):
+            raise TypeError("asynchronous capability query is not supported")
+        return value is True
+
+    def _round_down(self, candidate: Decimal) -> Decimal:
+        member = self._port.price_increment
+        increment = member() if callable(member) else member
+        tick = _decimal(increment, "price_increment", positive=True)
+        rounded = (candidate / tick).to_integral_value(rounding=ROUND_FLOOR) * tick
+        return _decimal(rounded, "rounded candidate", positive=True)
+
+    def _safe_lookup(self, order_id: str, *, now: datetime) -> ReplacementOutcome:
+        try:
+            return self._require_outcome(self._port.lookup_order(order_id))
+        except Exception as exc:
+            return ReplacementOutcome(
+                ReplacementStatus.UNKNOWN,
+                order_id,
+                observed_at=now,
+                detail=f"order lookup failed: {exc!r}",
+            )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _require_outcome(value: object) -> ReplacementOutcome:
+        if inspect.isawaitable(value):
+            raise TypeError("asynchronous stop replacement ports are not supported")
+        if not isinstance(value, ReplacementOutcome):
+            raise TypeError("stop replacement port must return ReplacementOutcome")
+        return value
+
+    def _record_intent(self, intent: Mapping[str, object]) -> None:
+        recorder = self._intent_recorder
+        method = getattr(recorder, "record_replacement_intent", None)
+        result = method(intent) if callable(method) else recorder(intent)  # type: ignore[operator]
+        if inspect.isawaitable(result):
+            raise TypeError("asynchronous intent recorders are not supported")
+
+    def _now(self) -> datetime:
+        source = self._clock
+        value: object = source() if callable(source) else source.now()
+        return _utc(value, "clock result")
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _tif(value: TimeInForce | str) -> TimeInForce:
+        if isinstance(value, TimeInForce):
+            return value
+        if isinstance(value, str):
+            try:
+                return TimeInForce[value.strip().upper()]
+            except KeyError:
+                pass
+        raise ValueError("tif must be TimeInForce.DAY or TimeInForce.GTC")

+"""Offline contract tests for protective-stop replacement and Alpaca mapping."""

+def outcome(
+    status: ReplacementStatus,
+    *,
+    order_id: str = OLD_ID,
+    broker_order_id: str | None = None,
+    price: str | None = None,
+    qty: str | None = None,
+    filled: str = "0",
+    remaining: str | None = None,
+    detail: str = "",
+) -> ReplacementOutcome:
+    return ReplacementOutcome(
+        status,
+        order_id,
+        broker_order_id=broker_order_id,
+        stop_price=None if price is None else Decimal(price),
+        quantity=None if qty is None else Decimal(qty),
+        filled_quantity=Decimal(filled),

+class FakePort:
+    def __init__(self, events: list[str]) -> None:
+        self.events = events
+        self.standalone = True
+        self.replace_capability = True
+        self.increment = Decimal("0.01")
+        self.replace_result = outcome(ReplacementStatus.UNKNOWN)
+        self.lookup_results: list[ReplacementOutcome] = [outcome(ReplacementStatus.UNKNOWN)]
+        self.replace_calls = 0
+
+    def supports_standalone_stop(self, *, qty: Decimal, tif: TimeInForce) -> bool:
+        return self.standalone and qty == qty.to_integral_value()
+
+    def supports_replace(self, *, qty: Decimal, tif: TimeInForce) -> bool:
+        return self.replace_capability and qty == qty.to_integral_value()

+        qty: Decimal,

+    def cancel_stop(self, order_id: str) -> ReplacementOutcome:

+class FakeTransport:
+    """Recorded HTTP transport: no credentials and no network implementation."""

+    def __init__(self, events: list[str]) -> None:

+        self.delete_result: object = None

+
+    @staticmethod

+        result = items.pop(0) if len(items) > 1 else items[0]
+        if isinstance(result, BaseException):

+    def get(self, path: str, *, params: object = None) -> object:
