def _require_text(value: Any, *, field: str) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty string")
    return value.strip()


def _decimal(value: Any, *, field: str, optional: bool = False) -> Decimal | None:
    if value is None:
        if optional:
            return None
        raise ValueError(f"{field} is required")
    if isinstance(value, bool) or isinstance(value, float):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be Decimal, int, or str")
    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
        result = value
    elif isinstance(value, int):
        result = Decimal(value)
    elif isinstance(value, str):
        try:
            result = Decimal(value.strip())
        except InvalidOperation:
            raise ValueError(f"{field} is not a valid decimal") from None
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be Decimal, int, or str")
    if not result.is_finite():
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be finite")
    return result


def _positive_decimal(value: Any, *, field: str) -> Decimal:
    result = _decimal(value, field=field)
    assert result is not None
    if result <= 0:
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be > 0")
    return result


def _base36(value: int) -> str:
    alphabet = "0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    if value == 0:
        return "0"
    encoded = ""
    while value:
        value, remainder = divmod(value, 36)
        encoded = alphabet[remainder] + encoded
    return encoded


def _purpose(value: OrderPurpose | str | Enum) -> OrderPurpose:
    if isinstance(value, OrderPurpose):
        return value
    raw = getattr(value, "value", value)
    if not isinstance(raw, str):
        raise ValueError("purpose must be an OrderPurpose or string")
    normalized = raw.strip().lower()
    aliases = {"strategy_exit": "exit"}
    normalized = aliases.get(normalized, normalized)
    try:
        return OrderPurpose(normalized)
    except ValueError:
        raise ValueError(f"unsupported order purpose: {raw!r}") from None


def make_client_order_id(
    mode: AlpacaEnvironment | str | Enum,
    account_fingerprint: str,
    cycle_id: str,
    purpose: OrderPurpose | str | Enum,
    attempt: int,
) -> str:
    """Return a deterministic, audit-inspectable ID no longer than 48 chars.

    The 128-bit truncated SHA-256 digest covers length-prefixed canonical input,
    while purpose and base-36 attempt remain directly inspectable.
    """

    raw_mode = getattr(mode, "value", mode)
    if not isinstance(raw_mode, str) or not raw_mode.strip():
        raise ValueError("mode must be a non-empty string or enum")
    fingerprint = _require_text(account_fingerprint, field="account_fingerprint")
    cycle = _require_text(cycle_id, field="cycle_id")
    resolved_purpose = _purpose(purpose)
    if isinstance(attempt, bool) or not isinstance(attempt, int) or attempt < 0:
        raise ValueError("attempt must be an int >= 0")
    components = (
        raw_mode.strip().upper(),
        fingerprint,
        cycle,
        resolved_purpose.value,
        str(attempt),
    )
    canonical = "".join(f"{len(item)}:{item}" for item in components)
    digest = hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:32]
    result = f"mt1-{_PURPOSE_CODES[resolved_purpose]}-{_base36(attempt)}-{digest}"
    if len(result) > 48:  # defensive: current format is at most 47 for bounded ints
        raise ValueError("attempt is too large for Alpaca's client_order_id limit")
    return result


def parse_client_order_id(client_order_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Inspect an ID generated by :func:`make_client_order_id`.

    Hashed identity inputs cannot be reversed; the result exposes the format
    version, purpose, attempt, and digest for audit and comparison.
    """

    value = _require_text(client_order_id, field="client_order_id")
    match = _CLIENT_ORDER_ID_RE.fullmatch(value)
    if match is None or match.group("purpose") not in _CODE_PURPOSES:
        raise ValueError("not a mike_trade Alpaca client_order_id")
    return {
        "version": 1,
        "purpose": _CODE_PURPOSES[match.group("purpose")],
        "attempt": int(match.group("attempt"), 36),
        "digest": match.group("digest"),
        "client_order_id": value,
    }


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class OrderSizing:
    """Explicit and mutually exclusive quantity-versus-notional selection."""
    """Explicit and mutually exclusive quantity-versus-notional selection."""

    qty: Decimal | int | str | None = None
    notional: Decimal | int | str | None = None

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if (self.qty is None) == (self.notional is None):
            raise ValueError("exactly one of qty or notional is required")
        if self.qty is not None:

    if value is None:
        return None
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a timezone-aware timestamp or null")
    text = value.strip()
    if text.endswith("Z"):
        text = text[:-1] + "+00:00"
    try:
        parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(text)
    except ValueError:
        raise ValueError(f"{field} is not a valid timestamp") from None
    if parsed.tzinfo is None or parsed.utcoffset() is None:
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be timezone-aware")
    return parsed.astimezone(UTC)


def _normalize_order(
    data: Mapping[str, Any], *, environment: AlpacaEnvironment
) -> AlpacaOrder:
    raw_legs = data.get("legs")
    if raw_legs is None:
        legs: tuple[AlpacaOrder, ...] = ()
    elif isinstance(raw_legs, list):
        if not all(isinstance(item, Mapping) for item in raw_legs):
            raise ValueError("order legs must be JSON objects")
        legs = tuple(_normalize_order(item, environment=environment) for item in raw_legs)
    else:
        raise ValueError("order legs must be a JSON array or null")

    def optional_decimal(name: str) -> Decimal | None:
        return _decimal(data.get(name), field=name, optional=True)

    order_class = data.get("order_class")
    if order_class is not None and not isinstance(order_class, str):
        raise ValueError("order_class must be a string or null")
    return AlpacaOrder(
        environment=environment,
        order_id=_require_text(data.get("id"), field="id"),
        client_order_id=_require_text(data.get("client_order_id"), field="client_order_id"),
        symbol=_require_text(data.get("symbol"), field="symbol").upper(),
        status=_require_text(data.get("status"), field="status").lower(),
        side=_require_text(data.get("side"), field="side").lower(),
        type=_require_text(data.get("type", data.get("order_type")), field="type").lower(),
        time_in_force=_require_text(data.get("time_in_force"), field="time_in_force").lower(),
        order_class=None if order_class is None else order_class.lower(),
        qty=optional_decimal("qty"),
        notional=optional_decimal("notional"),
        filled_qty=optional_decimal("filled_qty"),
        filled_avg_price=optional_decimal("filled_avg_price"),
        limit_price=optional_decimal("limit_price"),
        stop_price=optional_decimal("stop_price"),
        trail_price=optional_decimal("trail_price"),
        trail_percent=optional_decimal("trail_percent"),
        hwm=optional_decimal("hwm"),
        legs=legs,
        created_at=_parse_timestamp(data.get("created_at"), field="created_at"),
        updated_at=_parse_timestamp(data.get("updated_at"), field="updated_at"),
        submitted_at=_parse_timestamp(data.get("submitted_at"), field="submitted_at"),
        filled_at=_parse_timestamp(data.get("filled_at"), field="filled_at"),
        expired_at=_parse_timestamp(data.get("expired_at"), field="expired_at"),
        canceled_at=_parse_timestamp(data.get("canceled_at"), field="canceled_at"),
        failed_at=_parse_timestamp(data.get("failed_at"), field="failed_at"),
        replaced_at=_parse_timestamp(data.get("replaced_at"), field="replaced_at"),
    )


def _enum_string(value: str | Enum, *, field: str, allowed: frozenset[str]) -> str:
    raw = getattr(value, "value", value)
    if not isinstance(raw, str):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a string or enum")
    normalized = raw.strip().lower()
    if normalized not in allowed:
        raise ValueError(f"unsupported {field}: {raw!r}")
    return normalized


class AlpacaOrderService:
    """Synchronous order boundary over an injected Alpaca HTTP client."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        client: Any,
        *,
        persist_before_send: Callable[..., Any] | Any | None = None,
        environment: AlpacaEnvironment | None = None,
        fingerprint: str | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        for method in ("get", "post", "patch", "delete"):
            if not callable(getattr(client, method, None)):
                raise TypeError(f"client must expose {method}()")
        resolved_environment = (
            environment
            if environment is not None
            else getattr(client, "environment", None)
        )
        if not isinstance(resolved_environment, AlpacaEnvironment):
            raise TypeError("environment must be supplied or exposed by the client")
        resolved_fingerprint = (
            fingerprint
            if fingerprint is not None
            else getattr(client, "fingerprint", None)
        )
        if not isinstance(resolved_fingerprint, str) or not resolved_fingerprint.strip():
            raise ValueError("fingerprint must be supplied or exposed by the client")
        if persist_before_send is not None:
            candidate = getattr(persist_before_send, "persist_before_send", persist_before_send)
            if not callable(candidate):
                raise TypeError(
                    "persist_before_send must be callable or expose persist_before_send()"
                )
        self._client = client
        self._environment = resolved_environment
        self._fingerprint = resolved_fingerprint.strip()
        self._persist_hook = persist_before_send
        self._outstanding: dict[tuple[str, str], tuple[int, str]] = {}

    @property
    def environment(self) -> AlpacaEnvironment:
        return self._environment

    @property
    def fingerprint(self) -> str:
        return self._fingerprint

    def submit_order(
        self,
        *,
        asset: AlpacaAsset,
        side: str | Enum,
        order_type: str | Enum,
        sizing: OrderSizing | None = None,
        qty: Decimal | int | str | None = None,
        notional: Decimal | int | str | None = None,
        limit_price: Decimal | int | str | None = None,
        time_in_force: str | Enum = "day",
        cycle_id: str,
        purpose: OrderPurpose | str | Enum,
        attempt: int = 0,
        known_position_qty: Decimal | int | str | None = None,
    ) -> AlpacaOrder | NotSubmitted:
        """Submit a stock BUY/SELL market or limit order exactly once."""

        self._require_live_authorization()
        asset = self._validate_asset(asset)
        if sizing is not None and (qty is not None or notional is not None):
            raise ValueError("pass sizing or qty/notional, not both")
        resolved_sizing = sizing if sizing is not None else OrderSizing(qty=qty, notional=notional)
        if not isinstance(resolved_sizing, OrderSizing):
            raise TypeError("sizing must be an OrderSizing")
        resolved_side = _enum_string(side, field="side", allowed=frozenset({"buy", "sell"}))
        resolved_type = _enum_string(
            order_type, field="order_type", allowed=frozenset({"market", "limit"})
        )
        tif = _enum_string(
            time_in_force, field="time_in_force", allowed=frozenset({"day", "gtc"})
        )
        validated = self._validate_sizing(resolved_sizing, asset, tif=tif)
        if resolved_type == "limit":
            if limit_price is None:
                raise ValueError("limit orders require limit_price")
            price = quantize_price(limit_price, asset, strict=True)
        else:
            if limit_price is not None:
                raise ValueError("market orders must not specify limit_price")
            price = None
        validated_qty = validated.qty
        assert validated_qty is None or isinstance(validated_qty, Decimal)
        self._check_oversell(validated_qty, resolved_side, known_position_qty)
        body: dict[str, Any] = {
            "symbol": asset.symbol,
            "side": resolved_side,
            "type": resolved_type,
            "time_in_force": tif,
        }
        if validated.qty is not None:
            body["qty"] = str(validated.qty)
        else:
            body["notional"] = str(validated.notional)
        if price is not None:
            body["limit_price"] = str(price)
        return self._submit(body, cycle_id=cycle_id, purpose=purpose, attempt=attempt)

    def submit_stop_sell(

Status changes deliberately do not own executed quantity.  An event can carry

ledger as the authoritative owner of quantity changes.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from decimal import Decimal

    INTENT_PERSISTED = "INTENT_PERSISTED"
    SUBMITTING = "SUBMITTING"
    ACCEPTED = "ACCEPTED"
    PENDING = "PENDING"

    FILLED = "FILLED"
    REJECTED = "REJECTED"

    CANCELED = "CANCELED"
    EXPIRED = "EXPIRED"

TERMINAL_STATUSES = frozenset(
    {
        OrderStatus.FILLED,
        OrderStatus.REJECTED,
        OrderStatus.CANCELED,
        OrderStatus.EXPIRED,
        OrderStatus.REPLACED,

@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class OrderEvent:
    """One normalized broker/order-lifecycle observation.

    ``broker_lookup`` is required when resolving ``UNKNOWN``.  ``broker_confirmed``
    distinguishes final broker state from a local cancel/replace request or an
    acknowledgement that has not yet confirmed the final state.
    """

    status: OrderStatus
    filled_qty: Decimal | None = None
    broker_lookup: bool = False
    broker_confirmed: bool = True

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if not isinstance(self.status, OrderStatus):
            raise TypeError("status must be an OrderStatus")
        if not isinstance(self.broker_lookup, bool):
            raise TypeError("broker_lookup must be bool")
        if not isinstance(self.broker_confirmed, bool):
            raise TypeError("broker_confirmed must be bool")
        is_fill_status = self.status in {
            OrderStatus.PARTIALLY_FILLED,
            OrderStatus.FILLED,
        }
        if self.filled_qty is None:
            return
        if not isinstance(self.filled_qty, Decimal):
            raise TypeError("filled_qty must be Decimal")
        if not self.filled_qty.is_finite() or self.filled_qty <= 0:
            raise ValueError("filled_qty must be a finite positive Decimal")
        if not is_fill_status:
            raise ValueError("filled_qty may change only through fill-bearing events")


class IllegalOrderTransition(ValueError):
    """Typed evidence that an event cannot change the current order state."""

    def __init__(self, current: OrderStatus, event: OrderEvent, reason: str) -> None:
        self.current = current
        self.event = event
        self.reason = reason
        super().__init__(
            f"illegal order transition {current.value} -> {event.status.value}: {reason}"
        )


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class TransitionResult:
    previous_status: OrderStatus
    status: OrderStatus
    event: OrderEvent
    outcome: Literal["accepted", "ignored", "illegal"]
    error: IllegalOrderTransition | None = None

    @property
    def accepted(self) -> bool:
        return self.outcome == "accepted"

    @property
    def ignored(self) -> bool:
        return self.outcome == "ignored"

    @property
    def illegal(self) -> bool:
        return self.outcome == "illegal"

    @property
    def filled_qty(self) -> Decimal | None:
        """Return fill data only when its fill-bearing transition was accepted."""
        return self.event.filled_qty if self.accepted else None

    def raise_for_illegal(self) -> None:
        if self.error is not None:
            raise self.error


# The table is the complete transition policy.  Request acknowledgements are
# represented by CANCEL_PENDING; REPLACED appears only as broker-confirmed state.
_TRANSITIONS: dict[OrderStatus, frozenset[OrderStatus]] = {
    OrderStatus.INTENT_PERSISTED: frozenset({OrderStatus.SUBMITTING}),
    OrderStatus.SUBMITTING: frozenset(
        {
            OrderStatus.ACCEPTED,
            OrderStatus.PENDING,
            OrderStatus.REJECTED,
            OrderStatus.UNKNOWN,
        }
    ),
    OrderStatus.ACCEPTED: frozenset(
        {
            OrderStatus.PENDING,
            OrderStatus.PARTIALLY_FILLED,
            OrderStatus.FILLED,
            OrderStatus.REJECTED,
            OrderStatus.CANCEL_PENDING,
            OrderStatus.CANCELED,
            OrderStatus.EXPIRED,
            OrderStatus.REPLACED,
            OrderStatus.SUSPENDED,
        }
    ),
    OrderStatus.PENDING: frozenset(
        {
            OrderStatus.PARTIALLY_FILLED,
            OrderStatus.FILLED,
            OrderStatus.REJECTED,
            OrderStatus.CANCEL_PENDING,
            OrderStatus.CANCELED,
            OrderStatus.EXPIRED,
            OrderStatus.REPLACED,
            OrderStatus.SUSPENDED,
        }
    ),
    OrderStatus.PARTIALLY_FILLED: frozenset(
        {
            OrderStatus.FILLED,
            OrderStatus.CANCEL_PENDING,
            OrderStatus.CANCELED,
            OrderStatus.EXPIRED,
            OrderStatus.REPLACED,
            OrderStatus.SUSPENDED,
        }
    ),
    OrderStatus.CANCEL_PENDING: frozenset(
        {
            OrderStatus.PARTIALLY_FILLED,
            OrderStatus.FILLED,
            OrderStatus.CANCELED,
            OrderStatus.EXPIRED,
            OrderStatus.REPLACED,
            OrderStatus.SUSPENDED,
        }
    ),
    OrderStatus.SUSPENDED: frozenset(
        {
            OrderStatus.ACCEPTED,
            OrderStatus.PENDING,
            OrderStatus.PARTIALLY_FILLED,
            OrderStatus.FILLED,
            OrderStatus.REJECTED,
            OrderStatus.CANCEL_PENDING,
            OrderStatus.CANCELED,
            OrderStatus.EXPIRED,
            OrderStatus.REPLACED,
        }
    ),
    OrderStatus.UNKNOWN: frozenset(
        {
            OrderStatus.ACCEPTED,
            OrderStatus.PENDING,
            OrderStatus.PARTIALLY_FILLED,
            OrderStatus.FILLED,
            OrderStatus.REJECTED,
            OrderStatus.CANCEL_PENDING,
            OrderStatus.CANCELED,
            OrderStatus.EXPIRED,
            OrderStatus.REPLACED,
            OrderStatus.SUSPENDED,
        }
    ),
    OrderStatus.FILLED: frozenset(),
    OrderStatus.REJECTED: frozenset(),
    OrderStatus.CANCELED: frozenset(),
    OrderStatus.EXPIRED: frozenset(),
    OrderStatus.REPLACED: frozenset(),
}

_PROGRESS_RANK = {
    OrderStatus.INTENT_PERSISTED: 0,
    OrderStatus.SUBMITTING: 1,
    OrderStatus.ACCEPTED: 2,
    OrderStatus.PENDING: 3,
    OrderStatus.PARTIALLY_FILLED: 4,
    OrderStatus.CANCEL_PENDING: 5,
}


def _illegal(current: OrderStatus, event: OrderEvent, reason: str) -> TransitionResult:
    error = IllegalOrderTransition(current, event, reason)
    return TransitionResult(current, current, event, "illegal", error)


def apply_transition(current: OrderStatus, event: OrderEvent) -> TransitionResult:
    """Apply one event without side effects, returning explicit disposition evidence."""
    if not isinstance(current, OrderStatus):
        raise TypeError("current must be an OrderStatus")
    if not isinstance(event, OrderEvent):
        raise TypeError("event must be an OrderEvent")

    target = event.status
    if target is current:
        return TransitionResult(current, current, event, "ignored")
    if current in TERMINAL_STATUSES:
        return _illegal(current, event, "terminal states are immutable")
    if current is OrderStatus.UNKNOWN and not event.broker_lookup:
        return _illegal(current, event, "UNKNOWN may be resolved only by broker lookup")
    if target in {OrderStatus.CANCELED, OrderStatus.REPLACED} and not event.broker_confirmed:
        return _illegal(current, event, f"{target.value} requires broker confirmation")
    if (
        current is OrderStatus.CANCEL_PENDING
        and target in {OrderStatus.PARTIALLY_FILLED, OrderStatus.FILLED}
        and event.filled_qty is None
    ):
        return TransitionResult(current, current, event, "ignored")

    if target in _TRANSITIONS[current]:
        return TransitionResult(current, target, event, "accepted")

    current_rank = _PROGRESS_RANK.get(current)
    target_rank = _PROGRESS_RANK.get(target)
    if current_rank is not None and target_rank is not None and target_rank < current_rank:
        return TransitionResult(current, current, event, "ignored")

    return _illegal(current, event, "edge is absent from the transition table")
"""Exactly-once order submission with unknown-outcome recovery.

``OrderSubmitter`` turns an authorized f.2 command and a persisted f.1 intent
into at most one broker submission per ``client_order_id``:

* ``INTENT_PERSISTED -> SUBMITTING`` is persisted *before* the broker is called,
  and every later transition is persisted before the next step acts on it.
* Staleness is re-checked immediately before the network call; a stale intent is
  rejected locally and the broker is never contacted.
* Any submit failure other than an explicit broker rejection is an *unknown
  outcome*: the intent moves to ``UNKNOWN`` and is resolved only by looking the
  order up by its original ``client_order_id``.  The submitter never resubmits
  blindly and never mints a new ``client_order_id`` or attempt number.
* A fill is recorded only when the broker reports fill-bearing status together
  with a filled quantity; acceptance never implies a fill.

The FSM has no ``UNKNOWN -> SUBMITTING`` edge, so a confirmed not-found retry is
an explicit ledger *re-arm* (``resolve_not_found``) that restores the same intent
to ``INTENT_PERSISTED`` under the same ``client_order_id``.

Durability is injected through ``SubmissionLedger``: the f.1 ``IntentStore`` owns
only the initial intent record, so transition, annotation, and unresolved-marker
persistence is adapted here rather than added to f.1.
"""

def _parse_timestamp(value: Any, *, field: str) -> datetime | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a timezone-aware timestamp or null")
    text = value.strip()
    if text.endswith("Z"):
        text = text[:-1] + "+00:00"
    try:
        parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(text)
    except ValueError:
        raise ValueError(f"{field} is not a valid timestamp") from None
    if parsed.tzinfo is None or parsed.utcoffset() is None:
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be timezone-aware")
    return parsed.astimezone(UTC)

                field,
                _optional_decimal(
                    getattr(self, field), field=field, minimum=_ZERO, inclusive=False
                ),
            )
        _validate_order_prices(
            self.order_type,
            self.limit_price,
            self.stop_price,
            self.trail_price,
            self.trail_percent,
        )
        submitted = _require_utc(self.submitted_at, field="submitted_at")
        updated = _require_utc(self.updated_at, field="updated_at")
        if updated < submitted:
            raise ValueError("updated_at must not be before submitted_at")
        object.__setattr__(self, "submitted_at", submitted)
        object.__setattr__(self, "updated_at", updated)
        if self.replaced_by is not None:
            object.__setattr__(
                self, "replaced_by", _require_text(self.replaced_by, field="replaced_by")
            )

    @property
    def is_terminal(self) -> bool:
        return self.status in TERMINAL_ORDER_STATUSES

def _structural_status(descriptor: CapabilityDescriptor) -> CapabilityStatus | None:
    """Structural verdict, or None when the descriptor is structurally possible."""
    if descriptor.side == "short":
        return CapabilityStatus.UNSUPPORTED
    if descriptor.order_type == "trailing_stop" and descriptor.order_class != "simple":
        return CapabilityStatus.UNSUPPORTED
    if descriptor.operation == "replace" and descriptor.sizing == "notional":
        return CapabilityStatus.UNSUPPORTED
    return None


def _structural_reason(descriptor: CapabilityDescriptor) -> str | None:
    """Operator-readable reason for a structural UNSUPPORTED verdict."""
    if descriptor.side == "short":
        return "short selling is UNSUPPORTED: the desk trades long-only"
    if descriptor.order_type == "trailing_stop" and descriptor.order_class != "simple":
        return (
            "trailing_stop with order_class other than simple is never available: "
            "Alpaca supports standalone trailing stops only"
        )
    if descriptor.operation == "replace" and descriptor.sizing == "notional":
        return "notional orders cannot be replaced: Alpaca rejects notional replace"
    return None


def _ensure_descriptor(descriptor: Any) -> CapabilityDescriptor:
    if not isinstance(descriptor, CapabilityDescriptor):
        raise TypeError("descriptor must be a CapabilityDescriptor")
    return descriptor


_Entry = tuple[CapabilityStatus, CapabilityEvidence]


class BrokerCapabilities:
    """Fail-closed capability matrix keyed by environment and descriptor.

    The matrix stores only explicitly recorded entries. :meth:`status_of`
    resolves every other descriptor to ``UNPROVEN`` (structural impossibilities
    resolve to ``UNSUPPORTED``), so lookups never raise ``KeyError``.
    Instances are treated as immutable: promotion helpers return new instances.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        entries: Mapping[tuple[str, tuple[str, str, str, str, str, str]], _Entry] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._entries: dict[tuple[str, tuple[str, str, str, str, str, str]], _Entry] = (
            dict(entries) if entries else {}
        )

    def status_of(
        self, descriptor: CapabilityDescriptor, environment: AlpacaEnvironment | str
    ) -> CapabilityStatus:
        """Resolve the status for ``descriptor`` in ``environment`` (never KeyErrors)."""
        checked = _ensure_descriptor(descriptor)
        env = _ensure_environment(environment)
        structural = _structural_status(checked)
        if structural is not None:
            return structural
        stored = self._entries.get((env.value, checked.key()))
        if stored is not None:
            return stored[0]
        return CapabilityStatus.UNPROVEN

    def evidence_of(
        self, descriptor: CapabilityDescriptor, environment: AlpacaEnvironment | str
    ) -> CapabilityEvidence | None:
        """Return the recorded evidence, or None when nothing was recorded."""
        checked = _ensure_descriptor(descriptor)
        env = _ensure_environment(environment)
        stored = self._entries.get((env.value, checked.key()))
        return stored[1] if stored is not None else None

    def is_available(
        self, descriptor: CapabilityDescriptor, environment: AlpacaEnvironment | str
    ) -> bool:
        """Return True only when the descriptor is PROVEN for the environment."""
        return self.status_of(descriptor, environment) is CapabilityStatus.PROVEN

    def require(
        self, descriptor: CapabilityDescriptor, environment: AlpacaEnvironment | str
    ) -> CapabilityDescriptor:
        """Return ``descriptor`` when PROVEN; otherwise raise CapabilityUnavailable."""
        checked = _ensure_descriptor(descriptor)
        env = _ensure_environment(environment)
        if self.is_available(checked, env):
            return checked
        status = self.status_of(checked, env)
        reason = _structural_reason(checked) or f"status is {status.value}"
        evidence = self.evidence_of(checked, env)
        evidence_text = (
            f"; evidence={evidence.kind}:{evidence.reference} recorded {evidence.recorded_on}"
            if evidence is not None
            else "; no evidence recorded"
        )
        raise CapabilityUnavailable(
            checked.label(),
            f"Alpaca {env.value} capability {checked.label()!r} is unavailable "
            f"({reason}{evidence_text}). "
            "Promote it only with explicit paper verification (PAPER) or an "
            "explicit operator record (LIVE).",
        )

    def with_live_promotion(
        self, descriptor: CapabilityDescriptor, evidence: CapabilityEvidence
    ) -> BrokerCapabilities:
        """Return a copy with the LIVE entry promoted to PROVEN.

        ``evidence`` must be an explicit ``operator_record``; paper evidence and
        documentation can never promote LIVE. Structurally UNSUPPORTED
        descriptors can never be promoted.
        """
        checked = _ensure_descriptor(descriptor)
        if not isinstance(evidence, CapabilityEvidence):
            raise TypeError("evidence must be a CapabilityEvidence")
        if _structural_status(checked) is CapabilityStatus.UNSUPPORTED:
            raise CapabilityUnavailable(
                checked.label(),
                f"Alpaca LIVE capability {checked.label()!r} is structurally "
                f"unsupported ({_structural_reason(checked)}); it can never be promoted.",
            )
        if evidence.kind != "operator_record":
            raise ValueError(
                "LIVE promotion requires an explicit operator_record evidence entry; "
                f"got kind {evidence.kind!r}"
            )
        entries = dict(self._entries)
        entries[(AlpacaEnvironment.LIVE.value, checked.key())] = (CapabilityStatus.PROVEN, evidence)
        return BrokerCapabilities(entries)

    def as_legacy_checker(
        self, environment: AlpacaEnvironment | str
    ) -> Callable[[str], bool]:
        """Return a ``Callable[[str], bool]`` for the e.3 order service.

        Maps the order service's string capability names
        (``standalone_stop_sell:{whole|fractional}:{day|gtc}``,
        ``standalone_trailing_stop_sell:{whole|fractional}:{day|gtc}``,
        ``replace_{limit_price|stop_price|trail_price|trail_percent}``) onto
        descriptors. Unknown names fail closed (False). Legacy replace names
        resolve to True when any matching replace descriptor for that order
        type is PROVEN for the environment.
        """
        env = _ensure_environment(environment)

        def check(capability: str) -> bool:
            descriptor = _legacy_to_descriptor(capability)
            if descriptor is None:
                return False
            if descriptor.operation == "replace":
                return self._any_replace_available(descriptor.order_type, env)
            return self.is_available(descriptor, env)

        return check

    def _any_replace_available(self, order_type: str, env: AlpacaEnvironment) -> bool:
        for order_class in sorted(_ORDER_CLASSES):
            for sizing in sorted(_SIZINGS):
                for tif in sorted(_TIME_IN_FORCE):
                    for side in ("buy", "sell"):
                        candidate = CapabilityDescriptor(
                            order_type=order_type,
                            order_class=order_class,
                            sizing=sizing,
                            time_in_force=tif,
                            side=side,
                            operation="replace",
                        )
                        if self.is_available(candidate, env):
                            return True
        return False

    def explicit_entries(
        self,
    ) -> tuple[
        tuple[AlpacaEnvironment, CapabilityDescriptor, CapabilityStatus, CapabilityEvidence], ...
    ]:
        """Return the explicitly recorded entries (for operator tables and tests)."""
        result = []
        for (env_value, key), (status, evidence) in self._entries.items():
            result.append(
                (
                    AlpacaEnvironment(env_value),
                    CapabilityDescriptor(
                        order_type=key[0],
                        order_class=key[1],
                        sizing=key[2],
                        time_in_force=key[3],
                        side=key[4],
                        operation=key[5],
                    ),
                    status,
                    evidence,
                )
            )
        result.sort(key=lambda item: (item[0].value, item[1].label()))
        return tuple(result)


def _legacy_to_descriptor(capability: Any) -> CapabilityDescriptor | None:
    if not isinstance(capability, str):
        return None
    parts = capability.strip().lower().split(":")
    if len(parts) == 3 and parts[0] in {"standalone_stop_sell", "standalone_trailing_stop_sell"}:
        _, qty_word, tif = parts
        if qty_word not in _LEGACY_QTY_WORDS or tif not in _LEGACY_TIF_WORDS:
            return None
        order_type = "stop" if parts[0] == "standalone_stop_sell" else "trailing_stop"
        return CapabilityDescriptor(
            order_type=order_type,
            order_class="simple",
            sizing=qty_word,
            time_in_force=tif,
            side="sell",
            operation="submit",
        )
    if len(parts) == 1 and parts[0].startswith("replace_"):
        field = parts[0][len("replace_") :]
        order_type = _LEGACY_REPLACE_FIELDS.get(field)
        if order_type is None:
            return None
        return CapabilityDescriptor(
            order_type=order_type,
            order_class="simple",
            sizing="whole",
            time_in_force="day",
            side="sell",
            operation="replace",
        )
    return None


def default_alpaca_capabilities() -> BrokerCapabilities:
    """Return the initial Alpaca matrix for PAPER and LIVE.

    PROVEN-by-documentation (explicit operator record ``OP-ALPACA-DOC-2026-001``):

    - whole-share market/limit DAY/GTC simple buy/sell submit;
    - standalone whole-share trailing_stop sell (trail_price or trail_percent)
      DAY/GTC simple submit.

    Everything else defaults to UNPROVEN (stop-only OTO, bracket/OCO,
    fractional stop or linked orders, fractional trailing stop, stop-price
    replace, trailing replace, OTO replace, fractional GTC, extended TIFs),
    except the structural UNSUPPORTED rules (short selling, non-simple
    trailing_stop, notional replace).
    """
    entries: dict[tuple[str, tuple[str, str, str, str, str, str]], _Entry] = {}
    for env in (AlpacaEnvironment.PAPER, AlpacaEnvironment.LIVE):
        if env is AlpacaEnvironment.PAPER:
            basic_evidence = CapabilityEvidence(
                kind="documentation",
                reference=_DOC_ORDERS_REFERENCE,
                recorded_on=_OPERATOR_DOC_DATE,
                note=(
                    "PROVEN by provider documentation; pending paper verification. "
                    f"Operator record {_OPERATOR_DOC_RECORD}."
                ),
            )
            trailing_evidence = CapabilityEvidence(
                kind="documentation",
                reference=_DOC_TRAILING_REFERENCE,
                recorded_on=_OPERATOR_DOC_DATE,
                note=(
                    "Standalone trailing_stop sell with trail_price or trail_percent "
                    "is documented; pending paper verification. "
                    f"Operator record {_OPERATOR_DOC_RECORD}."
                ),
            )
        else:
            basic_evidence = CapabilityEvidence(
                kind="operator_record",
                reference=_OPERATOR_DOC_RECORD,
                recorded_on=_OPERATOR_DOC_DATE,
                note=(
                    "Explicit operator entry: whole-share market/limit simple submit "
                    f"is documented at {_DOC_ORDERS_REFERENCE}; LIVE order flow "
                    "additionally requires live authorization and paper verification "
                    "of any change before use."
                ),
            )
            trailing_evidence = CapabilityEvidence(
                kind="operator_record",
                reference=_OPERATOR_DOC_RECORD,
                recorded_on=_OPERATOR_DOC_DATE,
                note=(
                    "Explicit operator entry: standalone whole-share trailing_stop "
                    "sell is documented at "
                    f"{_DOC_TRAILING_REFERENCE}; LIVE order flow additionally "
                    "requires live authorization."
                ),
            )
        for order_type in ("market", "limit"):
            for tif in ("day", "gtc"):
                for side in ("buy", "sell"):
                    descriptor = CapabilityDescriptor(
                        order_type=order_type,
                        order_class="simple",
                        sizing="whole",
                        time_in_force=tif,
                        side=side,
                        operation="submit",
                    )
                    entries[(env.value, descriptor.key())] = (
                        CapabilityStatus.PROVEN,
                        basic_evidence,
                    )
        for tif in ("day", "gtc"):
            descriptor = CapabilityDescriptor(
                order_type="trailing_stop",
                order_class="simple",
                sizing="whole",
                time_in_force=tif,
                side="sell",
                operation="submit",
            )
            entries[(env.value, descriptor.key())] = (
                CapabilityStatus.PROVEN,
                trailing_evidence,
            )
    return BrokerCapabilities(entries)

class FakeClient:
    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        environment: AlpacaEnvironment = AlpacaEnvironment.PAPER,
        live_authorized: bool | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.environment = environment
        self.fingerprint = FP
        if live_authorized is not None:
            self.live_authorized = live_authorized
        self.calls: list[tuple[str, str, Any]] = []
        self.post_action: Any = order_json()
        self.patch_action: Any = order_json()
        self.delete_action: Any = None
        self.get_actions: dict[str, Any] = {}

    @staticmethod
    def _resolve(action: Any, *args: Any) -> Any:
        if isinstance(action, BaseException):
            raise action
        if callable(action):
            return action(*args)
        return action

    def get(self, path: str, *, params: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None) -> Any:
        self.calls.append(("GET", path, params))
        action = self.get_actions.get(path, AlpacaNotFound("missing", status_code=404))
        return self._resolve(action, path, params)

    def post(
        self,
        path: str,
        *,
        json_body: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
        params: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> Any:
        self.calls.append(("POST", path, dict(json_body or {})))
        return self._resolve(self.post_action, path, json_body, params)

    def patch(
        self,
        path: str,
        *,
        json_body: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
        params: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> Any:
        self.calls.append(("PATCH", path, dict(json_body or {})))
        return self._resolve(self.patch_action, path, json_body, params)

    def delete(self, path: str, *, params: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None) -> Any:
        self.calls.append(("DELETE", path, params))
        return self._resolve(self.delete_action, path, params)

class BrokerCapabilities:
    """Fail-closed capability matrix keyed by environment and descriptor.

    The matrix stores only explicitly recorded entries. :meth:`status_of`
    resolves every other descriptor to ``UNPROVEN`` (structural impossibilities
    resolve to ``UNSUPPORTED``), so lookups never raise ``KeyError``.
    Instances are treated as immutable: promotion helpers return new instances.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        entries: Mapping[tuple[str, tuple[str, str, str, str, str, str]], _Entry] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._entries: dict[tuple[str, tuple[str, str, str, str, str, str]], _Entry] = (
            dict(entries) if entries else {}
        )

    def status_of(
        self, descriptor: CapabilityDescriptor, environment: AlpacaEnvironment | str
    ) -> CapabilityStatus:
        """Resolve the status for ``descriptor`` in ``environment`` (never KeyErrors)."""
        checked = _ensure_descriptor(descriptor)
        env = _ensure_environment(environment)
        structural = _structural_status(checked)
        if structural is not None:
            return structural
        stored = self._entries.get((env.value, checked.key()))
        if stored is not None:
            return stored[0]
        return CapabilityStatus.UNPROVEN

    def evidence_of(
        self, descriptor: CapabilityDescriptor, environment: AlpacaEnvironment | str
    ) -> CapabilityEvidence | None:
        """Return the recorded evidence, or None when nothing was recorded."""
        checked = _ensure_descriptor(descriptor)
        env = _ensure_environment(environment)
        stored = self._entries.get((env.value, checked.key()))
        return stored[1] if stored is not None else None

    def is_available(
        self, descriptor: CapabilityDescriptor, environment: AlpacaEnvironment | str
    ) -> bool:
        """Return True only when the descriptor is PROVEN for the environment."""
        return self.status_of(descriptor, environment) is CapabilityStatus.PROVEN

    def require(
        self, descriptor: CapabilityDescriptor, environment: AlpacaEnvironment | str
    ) -> CapabilityDescriptor:
        """Return ``descriptor`` when PROVEN; otherwise raise CapabilityUnavailable."""
        checked = _ensure_descriptor(descriptor)
        env = _ensure_environment(environment)
        if self.is_available(checked, env):
            return checked
        status = self.status_of(checked, env)
        reason = _structural_reason(checked) or f"status is {status.value}"
        evidence = self.evidence_of(checked, env)
        evidence_text = (
            f"; evidence={evidence.kind}:{evidence.reference} recorded {evidence.recorded_on}"
            if evidence is not None
            else "; no evidence recorded"
        )
        raise CapabilityUnavailable(
            checked.label(),
            f"Alpaca {env.value} capability {checked.label()!r} is unavailable "
            f"({reason}{evidence_text}). "
            "Promote it only with explicit paper verification (PAPER) or an "
            "explicit operator record (LIVE).",
        )

    def with_live_promotion(
        self, descriptor: CapabilityDescriptor, evidence: CapabilityEvidence
    ) -> BrokerCapabilities:
        """Return a copy with the LIVE entry promoted to PROVEN.

        ``evidence`` must be an explicit ``operator_record``; paper evidence and
        documentation can never promote LIVE. Structurally UNSUPPORTED
        descriptors can never be promoted.
        """
        checked = _ensure_descriptor(descriptor)
        if not isinstance(evidence, CapabilityEvidence):
            raise TypeError("evidence must be a CapabilityEvidence")
        if _structural_status(checked) is CapabilityStatus.UNSUPPORTED:
            raise CapabilityUnavailable(
                checked.label(),
                f"Alpaca LIVE capability {checked.label()!r} is structurally "
                f"unsupported ({_structural_reason(checked)}); it can never be promoted.",
            )
        if evidence.kind != "operator_record":
            raise ValueError(
                "LIVE promotion requires an explicit operator_record evidence entry; "
                f"got kind {evidence.kind!r}"
            )
        entries = dict(self._entries)
        entries[(AlpacaEnvironment.LIVE.value, checked.key())] = (CapabilityStatus.PROVEN, evidence)
        return BrokerCapabilities(entries)

    def as_legacy_checker(
        self, environment: AlpacaEnvironment | str
    ) -> Callable[[str], bool]:
        """Return a ``Callable[[str], bool]`` for the e.3 order service.

        Maps the order service's string capability names
        (``standalone_stop_sell:{whole|fractional}:{day|gtc}``,
        ``standalone_trailing_stop_sell:{whole|fractional}:{day|gtc}``,
        ``replace_{limit_price|stop_price|trail_price|trail_percent}``) onto
        descriptors. Unknown names fail closed (False). Legacy replace names
        resolve to True when any matching replace descriptor for that order
        type is PROVEN for the environment.
        """
        env = _ensure_environment(environment)

        def check(capability: str) -> bool:
            descriptor = _legacy_to_descriptor(capability)
            if descriptor is None:
                return False
            if descriptor.operation == "replace":
                return self._any_replace_available(descriptor.order_type, env)
            return self.is_available(descriptor, env)

        return check

    def _any_replace_available(self, order_type: str, env: AlpacaEnvironment) -> bool:
        for order_class in sorted(_ORDER_CLASSES):
            for sizing in sorted(_SIZINGS):
                for tif in sorted(_TIME_IN_FORCE):
                    for side in ("buy", "sell"):
                        candidate = CapabilityDescriptor(
                            order_type=order_type,
                            order_class=order_class,
                            sizing=sizing,
                            time_in_force=tif,
                            side=side,
                            operation="replace",
                        )
                        if self.is_available(candidate, env):
                            return True
        return False

    def explicit_entries(
        self,
    ) -> tuple[
        tuple[AlpacaEnvironment, CapabilityDescriptor, CapabilityStatus, CapabilityEvidence], ...
    ]:
        """Return the explicitly recorded entries (for operator tables and tests)."""
        result = []
        for (env_value, key), (status, evidence) in self._entries.items():
            result.append(
                (
                    AlpacaEnvironment(env_value),
                    CapabilityDescriptor(
                        order_type=key[0],
                        order_class=key[1],
                        sizing=key[2],
                        time_in_force=key[3],
                        side=key[4],
                        operation=key[5],
                    ),
                    status,
                    evidence,
                )
            )
        result.sort(key=lambda item: (item[0].value, item[1].label()))
        return tuple(result)


def _legacy_to_descriptor(capability: Any) -> CapabilityDescriptor | None:
    if not isinstance(capability, str):
        return None
    parts = capability.strip().lower().split(":")
    if len(parts) == 3 and parts[0] in {"standalone_stop_sell", "standalone_trailing_stop_sell"}:
        _, qty_word, tif = parts
        if qty_word not in _LEGACY_QTY_WORDS or tif not in _LEGACY_TIF_WORDS:
            return None
        order_type = "stop" if parts[0] == "standalone_stop_sell" else "trailing_stop"
        return CapabilityDescriptor(
            order_type=order_type,
            order_class="simple",
            sizing=qty_word,
            time_in_force=tif,
            side="sell",
            operation="submit",
        )
    if len(parts) == 1 and parts[0].startswith("replace_"):
        field = parts[0][len("replace_") :]
        order_type = _LEGACY_REPLACE_FIELDS.get(field)
        if order_type is None:
            return None
        return CapabilityDescriptor(
            order_type=order_type,
            order_class="simple",
            sizing="whole",
            time_in_force="day",
            side="sell",
            operation="replace",
        )
    return None

    async def request_cancel(self, intent: OrderIntent) -> SubmissionResult:

        cid = intent.client_order_id

        except asyncio.CancelledError:

            self._ledger.annotate(intent, "CANCEL_REQUEST_ERROR", detail)

            "cancel_requested", intent, status, broker_order_id=broker_order_id, detail=detail

    async def request_replace(
        self,
        intent: OrderIntent,
        *,
        stop_price: Decimal | None = None,
        trail: Decimal | None = None,

    ) -> SubmissionResult:

        self._require_live_authorization(intent)
        requested = {

            "replace_trail_price": trail,
            "replace_quantity": quantity,

    async def confirm_from_broker(self, intent: OrderIntent) -> SubmissionResult:
        """Apply broker-confirmed state (cancel/replace/fill updates) via lookup.

        A failed or empty lookup leaves the persisted status untouched.
        """
        cid = intent.client_order_id
        status = self._ledger.status(cid)
        if status is None or status in TERMINAL_STATUSES:
            return self._result("refused", intent, status, detail="nothing to confirm")
        if status is OrderStatus.UNKNOWN:
            return await self._resolve_by_lookup(intent, status, source="confirm")
        try:
            order = await self._lookup(intent)
        except Exception as exc:
            return self._result("unconfirmed", intent, status, detail=f"lookup failed: {exc!r}")
        if order is None or order.client_order_id != cid:
            return self._result("unconfirmed", intent, status, detail="broker has no such order")
        event = _event_for(order, lookup=True)
        if event is None:
            return self._result("unconfirmed", intent, status, detail="broker status unknown")
        status = self._apply(
            intent, status, event, reason="confirm", broker_order_id=order.broker_order_id
        )
        return self._result(
            "resolved", intent, status,
            broker_order_id=order.broker_order_id, filled_qty=event.filled_qty,

+"""Alpaca implementation of the provider-neutral stop replacement port.
+
+Only the injected HTTP/SDK client is used.  This module never constructs a
+client, reads credentials, or performs implicit network access.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
+from enum import Enum
+from typing import Any
+
+from mike_trade.domain.trading import TimeInForce
+from mike_trade.execution.replace import ReplacementOutcome, ReplacementStatus
+
+__all__ = ["AlpacaStopReplacementAdapter"]
+
+_ZERO = Decimal("0")
+_OPEN = frozenset({"accepted", "new", "pending_new", "pending_replace"})
+
+
+def _positive_decimal(value: object, name: str) -> Decimal:
+    if isinstance(value, bool) or isinstance(value, float):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be Decimal, int, or str")
+    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        result = value
+    elif isinstance(value, int):
+        result = Decimal(value)
+    elif isinstance(value, str):
+        try:
+            result = Decimal(value.strip())
+        except InvalidOperation:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} is not a valid Decimal") from None
+    else:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be Decimal, int, or str")
+    if not result.is_finite() or result <= _ZERO:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a finite value > 0")
+    return result
+
+
+def _text(value: object, name: str) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a non-empty string")
+    return value.strip()
+
+
+def _value(data: object, *names: str) -> object | None:
+    if isinstance(data, Mapping):
+        for name in names:
+            if name in data:
+                return data[name]
+        return None
+    for name in names:
+        if hasattr(data, name):
+            return getattr(data, name)
+    return None
+
+
+class AlpacaStopReplacementAdapter:
+    """Single-shot PATCH/DELETE adapter with explicit capability flags."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        client: object,
+        *,
+        price_increment: Decimal,
+        standalone_stop_verified: bool = True,
+        replace_verified: bool = True,
+        fractional_stop_verified_in_paper: bool = False,
+    ) -> None:
+        if client is None:
+            raise TypeError("client is required")
+        self._client = client
+        self._price_increment = _positive_decimal(price_increment, "price_increment")
+        for name, value in (
+            ("standalone_stop_verified", standalone_stop_verified),
+            ("replace_verified", replace_verified),
+            ("fractional_stop_verified_in_paper", fractional_stop_verified_in_paper),
+        ):
+            if not isinstance(value, bool):
+                raise TypeError(f"{name} must be bool")
+        self._standalone_stop_verified = standalone_stop_verified
+        self._replace_verified = replace_verified
+        self._fractional_stop_verified = fractional_stop_verified_in_paper
+        self._requests: dict[str, tuple[Decimal, Decimal, str | None]] = {}
+
+    def supports_standalone_stop(self, *, qty: Decimal, tif: TimeInForce) -> bool:
+        quantity = _positive_decimal(qty, "qty")
+        self._tif(tif)
+        return self._standalone_stop_verified and (
+            quantity == quantity.to_integral_value() or self._fractional_stop_verified
+        )
+
+    def supports_replace(self, *, qty: Decimal, tif: TimeInForce) -> bool:
+        quantity = _positive_decimal(qty, "qty")
+        self._tif(tif)
+        return self._replace_verified and (
+            quantity == quantity.to_integral_value() or self._fractional_stop_verified
+        )
+
+    def price_increment(self) -> Decimal:
+        return self._price_increment
+
+    def replace_stop(
+        self,
+        order_id: str,
+        new_stop_price: Decimal,
+        qty: Decimal,
+        tif: TimeInForce,
+        client_order_id: str,
+    ) -> ReplacementOutcome:
+        old_id = _text(order_id, "order_id")
+        price = _positive_decimal(new_stop_price, "new_stop_price")
+        quantity = _positive_decimal(qty, "qty")
+        tif_value = self._tif(tif)
+        client_id = _text(client_order_id, "client_order_id")
+        if not self.supports_standalone_stop(qty=quantity, tif=tif):
+            return self._unsupported(old_id, "standalone stop combination is not verified")
+        if not self.supports_replace(qty=quantity, tif=tif):
+            return self._unsupported(old_id, "stop replacement combination is not verified")
+        body = {
+            "stop_price": str(price),
+            "qty": str(quantity),
+            "time_in_force": tif_value,
+            "client_order_id": client_id,
+        }
+        try:
+            data = self._patch(old_id, body)
+        except Exception as exc:
+            return ReplacementOutcome(
+                ReplacementStatus.UNKNOWN,
+                old_id,
+                observed_at=datetime.now(UTC),
+                detail=f"Alpaca replace outcome unknown: {exc!r}",
+            )
+        result = self._map(data, protected_order_id=old_id, mutation="replace")
+        self._requests[old_id] = (price, quantity, result.broker_order_id)
+        if result.status is ReplacementStatus.CONFIRMED:
+            result = self._apply_requested(result, old_id)
+        return result
+
+    def cancel_stop(self, order_id: str) -> ReplacementOutcome:
+        old_id = _text(order_id, "order_id")
+        try:
+            data = self._delete(old_id)
+        except Exception as exc:
+            status_code = getattr(exc, "status_code", None)
+            if status_code not in {404, 422}:
+                return ReplacementOutcome(
+                    ReplacementStatus.UNKNOWN,
+                    old_id,
+                    observed_at=datetime.now(UTC),
+                    detail=f"Alpaca cancel outcome unknown: {exc!r}",
+                )
+            # A terminal response needs lookup to distinguish cancel from fill.
+            return self.lookup_order(old_id)
+        if data is None:
+            return ReplacementOutcome(
+                ReplacementStatus.UNKNOWN,
+                old_id,
+                observed_at=datetime.now(UTC),
+                detail="Alpaca accepted cancellation; final status is unconfirmed",
+            )
+        return self._map(data, protected_order_id=old_id, mutation="cancel")
+
+    def lookup_order(self, order_id: str) -> ReplacementOutcome:
+        old_id = _text(order_id, "order_id")
+        try:
+            data = self._get(old_id)
+        except Exception as exc:
+            return ReplacementOutcome(
+                ReplacementStatus.UNKNOWN,
+                old_id,
+                observed_at=datetime.now(UTC),
+                detail=f"Alpaca lookup failed: {exc!r}",
+            )
+        if data is None:
+            return ReplacementOutcome(
+                ReplacementStatus.UNKNOWN,
+                old_id,
+                observed_at=datetime.now(UTC),
+                detail="Alpaca lookup returned no order",
+            )
+        result = self._map(data, protected_order_id=old_id, mutation="lookup")
+        if result.status is ReplacementStatus.CONFIRMED and old_id in self._requests:
+            result = self._apply_requested(result, old_id)
+        return result
+
+    def outcome_from_trade_update(
+        self, update: object, *, protected_order_id: str
+    ) -> ReplacementOutcome:
+        """Map an already-authenticated Alpaca trade update without doing I/O."""
+
+        payload = _value(update, "order") or update
+        event = _value(update, "event")
+        if event is not None:
+            if isinstance(payload, Mapping):
+                payload = dict(payload)
+                payload["status"] = getattr(event, "value", event)
+            elif hasattr(payload, "status"):
+                # Normalized TradeUpdate.order already carries the same status.
+                pass
+        result = self._map(payload, protected_order_id=protected_order_id, mutation="update")
+        if result.status is ReplacementStatus.CONFIRMED and protected_order_id in self._requests:
+            result = self._apply_requested(result, protected_order_id)
+        return result
+
+    def _apply_requested(self, result: ReplacementOutcome, old_id: str) -> ReplacementOutcome:
+        from dataclasses import replace
+
+        price, quantity, submitted_id = self._requests[old_id]
+        return replace(
+            result,
+            broker_order_id=result.broker_order_id or submitted_id or old_id,
+            stop_price=result.stop_price or price,
+            quantity=result.quantity or quantity,
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _unsupported(order_id: str, detail: str) -> ReplacementOutcome:
+        return ReplacementOutcome(
+            ReplacementStatus.UNSUPPORTED,
+            order_id,
+            observed_at=datetime.now(UTC),
+            detail=detail,
+        )
+
+    def _map(
+        self, data: object, *, protected_order_id: str, mutation: str
+    ) -> ReplacementOutcome:
+        status_value = _value(data, "status")
+        raw_status = getattr(status_value, "value", status_value)
+        status = str(raw_status or "unknown").strip().lower()
+        order_id_value = _value(data, "id", "order_id", "broker_order_id")
+        current_id = str(order_id_value).strip() if order_id_value else None
+        replacement_value = _value(data, "replaced_by", "replacement_order_id")
+        replacement_id = str(replacement_value).strip() if replacement_value else None
+        qty = self._optional_decimal(_value(data, "qty", "quantity"), "qty")
+        filled = self._optional_decimal(
+            _value(data, "filled_qty", "filled_quantity"), "filled_qty"
+        ) or _ZERO
+        stop = self._optional_decimal(_value(data, "stop_price"), "stop_price")
+        observed_at = self._timestamp(_value(data, "updated_at", "timestamp"))
+
+        if status == "replaced":
+            return ReplacementOutcome(
+                ReplacementStatus.CONFIRMED,
+                protected_order_id,
+                broker_order_id=replacement_id or current_id or protected_order_id,
+                stop_price=stop or self._requested_price(protected_order_id),
+                quantity=qty or self._requested_qty(protected_order_id),
+                observed_at=observed_at,
+                detail="Alpaca confirmed order replacement",
+            )
+        if status in {"filled", "partially_filled", "partial_fill"}:
+            if filled <= _ZERO and status == "filled" and qty is not None:
+                filled = qty
+            remaining = max(_ZERO, (qty or filled) - filled)
+            return ReplacementOutcome(
+                ReplacementStatus.STOP_FILLED_DURING_REPLACE,
+                protected_order_id,
+                broker_order_id=current_id or protected_order_id,
+                filled_quantity=filled,
+                remaining_quantity=remaining,
+                observed_at=observed_at,
+                detail=f"old Alpaca stop was {status} during {mutation}",
+            )
+        if status == "rejected":
+            return ReplacementOutcome(
+                ReplacementStatus.REJECTED,
+                protected_order_id,
+                broker_order_id=current_id,
+                observed_at=observed_at,
+                detail="Alpaca rejected the stop mutation",
+            )
+        if status == "canceled" and mutation in {"cancel", "lookup"}:
+            # A confirmed cancellation is represented as CONFIRMED.  The
+            # coordinator's cancel path supplies its prior stop/quantity.
+            requested_price = self._requested_price(protected_order_id)
+            requested_qty = self._requested_qty(protected_order_id)
+            if requested_price is not None and requested_qty is not None:
+                return ReplacementOutcome(
+                    ReplacementStatus.CONFIRMED,
+                    protected_order_id,
+                    broker_order_id=current_id or protected_order_id,
+                    stop_price=requested_price,
+                    quantity=requested_qty,
+                    observed_at=observed_at,
+                    detail="Alpaca confirmed cancellation",
+                )
+            return ReplacementOutcome(
+                ReplacementStatus.UNKNOWN,
+                protected_order_id,
+                broker_order_id=current_id,
+                observed_at=observed_at,
+                detail="Alpaca confirmed cancellation; no replacement is confirmed",
+            )
+        detail = (
+            "Alpaca acknowledged replacement but has not confirmed it"
+            if status in _OPEN
+            else f"Alpaca status {status!r} does not confirm replacement"
+        )
+        return ReplacementOutcome(
+            ReplacementStatus.UNKNOWN,
+            protected_order_id,
+            broker_order_id=current_id,
+            stop_price=stop,
+            quantity=qty,
+            observed_at=observed_at,
+            detail=detail,
+        )
+
+    def _patch(self, order_id: str, body: Mapping[str, str]) -> object:
+        method = getattr(self._client, "patch", None)
+        if callable(method):
+            return method(f"/v2/orders/{order_id}", json_body=dict(body), params=None)
+        method = getattr(self._client, "replace_order_by_id", None)
+        if callable(method):
+            return method(order_id, **dict(body))
+        method = getattr(self._client, "replace_order", None)
+        if callable(method):
+            return method(order_id, **dict(body))
+        raise TypeError("client must expose patch, replace_order_by_id, or replace_order")
+
+    def _delete(self, order_id: str) -> object:
+        method = getattr(self._client, "delete", None)
+        if callable(method):
+            return method(f"/v2/orders/{order_id}", params=None)
+        for name in ("cancel_order_by_id", "cancel_order"):
+            method = getattr(self._client, name, None)
+            if callable(method):
+                return method(order_id)
+        raise TypeError("client must expose delete, cancel_order_by_id, or cancel_order")
+
+    def _get(self, order_id: str) -> object:
+        method = getattr(self._client, "get", None)
+        if callable(method):
+            return method(f"/v2/orders/{order_id}", params=None)
+        for name in ("get_order_by_id", "get_order"):
+            method = getattr(self._client, name, None)
+            if callable(method):
+                return method(order_id)
+        raise TypeError("client must expose get, get_order_by_id, or get_order")
+
+    def _requested_price(self, order_id: str) -> Decimal | None:
+        request = self._requests.get(order_id)
+        return None if request is None else request[0]
+
+    def _requested_qty(self, order_id: str) -> Decimal | None:
+        request = self._requests.get(order_id)
+        return None if request is None else request[1]
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _optional_decimal(value: object | None, name: str) -> Decimal | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        return _positive_decimal(value, name)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _timestamp(value: object | None) -> datetime:
+        if value is None:
+            return datetime.now(UTC)
+        if isinstance(value, datetime):
+            parsed = value
+        elif isinstance(value, str):
+            text = value.strip().replace("Z", "+00:00")
+            parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(text)
+        else:
+            return datetime.now(UTC)
+        if parsed.tzinfo is None or parsed.utcoffset() is None:
+            raise ValueError("Alpaca timestamp must be timezone-aware")
+        return parsed.astimezone(UTC)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _tif(value: TimeInForce | str | Enum) -> str:
+        raw = getattr(value, "value", value)
+        if not isinstance(raw, str) or raw.strip().lower() not in {"day", "gtc"}:
+            raise ValueError("tif must be DAY or GTC")
+        return raw.strip().lower()
